// Fetch property types for the filter dropdown
$property_types = [];
$sql_property_types = "SELECT PropertyTypeID, TypeName FROM PropertyTypes ORDER BY TypeName";
if ($stmt_types = $conn->prepare($sql_property_types)) {
    if ($stmt_types->execute()) {
        $result_types = $stmt_types->get_result();
        while ($row_type = $result_types->fetch_assoc()) {
            $property_types[$row_type['PropertyTypeID']] = $row_type['TypeName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_types->close();
}

// Build the main SQL query with proper joins for unit design and finishing type
$sql_select = "SELECT p.*, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               pud.DesignName AS UnitDesignName, pft.FinishingName AS FinishingTypeName
               FROM Properties p
               LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
               LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
               LEFT JOIN PropertyUnitDesigns pud ON p.unit_design_id = pud.DesignID
               LEFT JOIN PropertyFinishingTypes pft ON p.finishing_type_id = pft.FinishingID";
$sql_where = [];
$params = [];
$types = "";

// Add search term filter
if (!empty($search_term)) {
    $sql_where[] = "(p.Title LIKE ? OR p.ProjectName LIKE ? OR p.governorate LIKE ? OR p.district LIKE ? OR p.Location LIKE ? OR p.company_name LIKE ? OR pud.DesignName LIKE ?)";
    $search_param = "%" . $search_term . "%";
    array_push($params, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param);
    $types .= "sssssss";
}

// Add property type filter
if (!empty($property_type_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
    $params[] = $property_type_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add governorate filter
if (!empty($governorate_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.governorate = ?";
    $params[] = $governorate_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add company filter
if (!empty($company_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.company_name = ?";
    $params[] = $company_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add unit design filter
if (!empty($unit_design_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.unit_design_id = ?";
    $params[] = $unit_design_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add status filter
if (!empty($status_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.Status = ?";
    $params[] = $status_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add advanced filters
if (!empty($min_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Price, p.min_price) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Price, p.max_price) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($min_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.min_area) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.max_area) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($down_payment_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.down_payment_percentage = ?";
    $params[] = $down_payment_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($payment_period_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.payment_years = ?";
    $params[] = $payment_period_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add property type filter for residential properties
$sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
$params[] = CURRENT_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID;
$types .= "i";

// Combine SQL parts
$sql = $sql_select;
if (!empty($sql_where)) {
    $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $sql_where);
}

// Add sorting
$sql .= " ORDER BY " . $allowed_sort_columns[$sort_column] . " " . strtoupper($sort_direction);

// Prepare and execute the query
$properties = [];
if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    if (!empty($params)) {
        $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
    }

    if ($stmt->execute()) {
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $properties[] = $row;
        }
    } else {
        error_log("Error executing property query: " . $stmt->error . " | SQL: " . $sql . " | Params: " . print_r($params, true));
        $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('database_error');
    }
    $stmt->close();
} else {
    error_log("Error preparing property query: " . $conn->error . " | SQL: " . $sql);
    $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('db_error_prepare');
}

// Function to format price for display
function formatDisplayPrice($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['Price']) && is_numeric($row['Price'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['Price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_price']) && is_numeric($row['min_price']) && !empty($row['max_price']) && is_numeric($row['max_price'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['min_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_price']) && is_numeric($row['min_price'])) {
        return t('starts_from') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($row['min_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['max_price']) && is_numeric($row['max_price'])) {
        return t('up_to') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    }
    return t('price_not_specified');
}

// Function to format area for display
function formatDisplayArea($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['Area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area']) && !empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area'])) {
        return t("starts_from") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["min_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    } elseif (!empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return t("up_to") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["max_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    }
    return t('area_not_specified');
}

// Function to format payment terms
function formatPaymentTerms($row)
{
    $terms = [];
    
    if (!empty($row['down_payment_percentage']) && is_numeric($row['down_payment_percentage'])) {
        $terms[] = number_format($row['down_payment_percentage'], 0) . '% ' . t('down_payment_percentage');
    }
    
    if (!empty($row['payment_years']) && is_numeric($row['payment_years'])) {
        $terms[] = $row['payment_years'] . ' ' . t('years');
    }
    
    return !empty($terms) ? implode(' + ', $terms) : t('undefined');
}

// Function to get status badge HTML
function getStatusBadge($status) {
    $status_classes = [
        'available' => 'status-available',
        'sold' => 'status-sold', 
        'rented' => 'status-rented',
        'unavailable' => 'status-unavailable'
    ];
    
    $status_icons = [
        'available' => 'fas fa-check-circle',
        'sold' => 'fas fa-handshake',
        'rented' => 'fas fa-key',
        'unavailable' => 'fas fa-times-circle'
    ];
    
    $class = $status_classes[$status] ?? 'status-unavailable';
    $icon = $status_icons[$status] ?? 'fas fa-question-circle';
    $text = t('status_' . $status);
    
    return "<span class=\"status-badge {$class}\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$text}</span>";
}

// Function to get property type badge HTML
function getPropertyTypeBadge($typeId, $typeName) {
    $type_icons = [
        1 => 'fas fa-home',      // سكني
        2 => 'fas fa-umbrella-beach', // ساحلي
        3 => 'fas fa-building',  // إداري
        4 => 'fas fa-store',     // تجاري
        5 => 'fas fa-hotel',     // فندقي
        6 => 'fas fa-hospital'   // طبي
    ];
    
    $icon = $type_icons[$typeId] ?? 'fas fa-landmark';
    
    return "<span class=\"property-type-badge\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$typeName}</span>";
}

    function toggleAdvancedFilters() {
        const advancedFilters = document.getElementById('advancedFilters');
        const toggleButton = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters-toggle');
        
        if (advancedFilters.classList.contains('show')) {
            advancedFilters.classList.remove('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sliders-h"></i> <?php echo t('advanced_filters'); ?>';
        } else {
            advancedFilters.classList.add('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> <?php echo t('hide_advanced_filters'); ?>';
        }
    }
    
    // Show advanced filters if any of them are set
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

            !empty($min_price_filter) ||

            !empty($down_payment_filter) ||
            !empty($payment_period_filter) ? 'true' : 'false';
        ?>;
        
        if (hasAdvancedFilters) {
            toggleAdvancedFilters();
        }
    });

<?php
// Include configuration
require_once 'config.php';

// Start session if not already started
if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Check if user is logged in
if (!isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) || $_SESSION["loggedin"] !== true) {
    header("Location: login.php");
    exit;
}

// Initialize session timestamps if not set
if (!isset($_SESSION['created_at'])) {
    $_SESSION['created_at'] = time();
}

if (!isset($_SESSION['last_activity'])) {
    $_SESSION['last_activity'] = time();
}

$current_time = time();

// Check for absolute timeout
if (($current_time - $_SESSION['created_at']) > SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT) {
    session_unset();
    session_destroy();
    header("Location: login.php?timeout=absolute");
    exit;
}

// Check for idle timeout
if (($current_time - $_SESSION['last_activity']) > SESSION_TIMEOUT) {
    session_unset();
    session_destroy();
    header("Location: login.php?timeout=idle");
    exit;
}

// Update last activity timestamp
$_SESSION['last_activity'] = $current_time;

// Calculate time remaining for warnings
$idle_time_remaining = SESSION_TIMEOUT - ($current_time - $_SESSION['last_activity']);
$absolute_time_remaining = SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT - ($current_time - $_SESSION['created_at']);

// Set session warning flags for JavaScript
$_SESSION['idle_warning'] = ($idle_time_remaining <= SESSION_WARNING_TIME);
$_SESSION['absolute_warning'] = ($absolute_time_remaining <= SESSION_WARNING_TIME);
$_SESSION['idle_time_remaining'] = $idle_time_remaining;
$_SESSION['absolute_time_remaining'] = $absolute_time_remaining;
?>

FILE: session_status.php

<?php
header('Content-Type: application/json');

// Include session check
require_once 'session_check.php';

$current_time = time();
$response = array();

// Check if session is still valid (session_check.php would have redirected if expired)
$response['expired'] = false;

// Check for warnings
$idle_time_remaining = SESSION_TIMEOUT - ($current_time - $_SESSION['last_activity']);
$absolute_time_remaining = SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT - ($current_time - $_SESSION['created_at']);

$response['warning'] = false;
$response['timeout_type'] = '';
$response['time_remaining'] = 0;

// Check for idle timeout warning
if ($idle_time_remaining <= SESSION_WARNING_TIME && $idle_time_remaining > 0) {
    $response['warning'] = true;
    $response['timeout_type'] = 'idle';
    $response['time_remaining'] = $idle_time_remaining;
}

// Check for absolute timeout warning (takes precedence if both are active)
if ($absolute_time_remaining <= SESSION_WARNING_TIME && $absolute_time_remaining > 0) {
    $response['warning'] = true;
    $response['timeout_type'] = 'absolute';
    $response['time_remaining'] = $absolute_time_remaining;
}

echo json_encode($response);
?>

FILE: session_timeout.js

// Session timeout warning system
class SessionTimeoutManager {
    constructor() {
        this.warningShown = false;
        this.checkInterval = 30000; // Check every 30 seconds
        this.warningDialog = null;
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        // Start checking session status
        this.startSessionCheck();
        
        // Add event listeners for user activity
        this.addActivityListeners();
    }

    startSessionCheck() {
        setInterval(() => {
            this.checkSessionStatus();
        }, this.checkInterval);
    }

    addActivityListeners() {
        // Reset warning when user is active
        const events = ['mousedown', 'mousemove', 'keypress', 'scroll', 'touchstart', 'click'];
        events.forEach(event => {
            document.addEventListener(event, () => {
                if (this.warningShown) {
                    this.hideWarning();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    async checkSessionStatus() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('session_status.php', {
                method: 'GET',
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.expired) {
                // Session has expired, redirect to login
                window.location.href = 'login.php?timeout=' + data.timeout_type;
                return;
            }
            
            if (data.warning && !this.warningShown) {
                this.showWarning(data.time_remaining, data.timeout_type);
            }
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error checking session status:', error);
        }
    }

    showWarning(timeRemaining, timeoutType) {
        this.warningShown = true;
        
        const minutes = Math.floor(timeRemaining / 60);
        const seconds = timeRemaining % 60;
        const timeString = `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
        
        const message = timeoutType === 'idle' 
            ? `Your session will expire due to inactivity in ${timeString}. Click anywhere to continue.`
            : `Your session will expire in ${timeString} due to maximum session time. Please save your work.`;
        
        // Create warning dialog
        this.warningDialog = document.createElement('div');
        this.warningDialog.className = 'session-warning-dialog';
        this.warningDialog.innerHTML = `
            <div class="session-warning-content">
                <div class="session-warning-icon">⚠️</div>
                <div class="session-warning-message">${message}</div>
                <div class="session-warning-buttons">
                    <button onclick="sessionManager.extendSession()" class="btn btn-primary">Extend Session</button>
                    <button onclick="sessionManager.logout()" class="btn btn-secondary">Logout</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(this.warningDialog);
        
        // Add CSS if not already added
        if (!document.getElementById('session-warning-styles')) {
            const style = document.createElement('style');
            style.id = 'session-warning-styles';
            style.textContent = `
                .session-warning-dialog {
                    position: fixed;
                    top: 0;
                    left: 0;
                    width: 100%;
                    height: 100%;
                    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
                    display: flex;
                    justify-content: center;
                    align-items: center;
                    z-index: 10000;
                }
                .session-warning-content {
                    background: white;
                    padding: 30px;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    text-align: center;
                    max-width: 400px;
                    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
                }
                .session-warning-icon {
                    font-size: 48px;
                    margin-bottom: 15px;
                }
                .session-warning-message {
                    font-size: 16px;
                    margin-bottom: 20px;
                    color: #333;
                }
                .session-warning-buttons {
                    display: flex;
                    gap: 10px;
                    justify-content: center;
                }
                .session-warning-buttons .btn {
                    padding: 10px 20px;
                    border: none;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    font-size: 14px;
                }
                .session-warning-buttons .btn-primary {
                    background: #007bff;
                    color: white;
                }
                .session-warning-buttons .btn-secondary {
                    background: #6c757d;
                    color: white;
                }
                .session-warning-buttons .btn:hover {
                    opacity: 0.9;
                }
            `;
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }
    }

    hideWarning() {
        if (this.warningDialog) {
            this.warningDialog.remove();
            this.warningDialog = null;
        }
        this.warningShown = false;
    }

    async extendSession() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('extend_session.php', {
                method: 'POST',
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            });
            
            if (response.ok) {
                this.hideWarning();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error extending session:', error);
        }
    }

    logout() {
        window.location.href = 'logout.php';
    }
}

// Initialize session manager when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    window.sessionManager = new SessionTimeoutManager();
});

<?php
// Helper function to generate sorting URL
function getSortUrl($column, $current_sort, $current_direction) {
    $new_direction = ($current_sort === $column && $current_direction === 'asc') ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    
    // Preserve current filters
    $params = $_GET;
    $params['sort'] = $column;
    $params['direction'] = $new_direction;
    
    return '?' . http_build_query($params);
}

// Helper function to get sort icon
function getSortIcon($column, $current_sort, $current_direction) {
    if ($current_sort !== $column) {
        return '<i class="fas fa-sort sort-icon"></i>';
    }
    
    if ($current_direction === 'asc') {
        return '<i class="fas fa-sort-up sort-icon active"></i>';
    } else {
        return '<i class="fas fa-sort-down sort-icon active"></i>';
    }
}

<?php
// This script updates the index_properties.php file to include the new fields from Excel data

// Read the original file

// Find the position of the SQL query for fetching properties
$sql_query_position = strpos($original_content, '$sql = "SELECT p.PropertyID, p.Title, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, p.Price, p.Location');

// Update the SQL query to include new fields
$new_sql_query = '$sql = "SELECT p.PropertyID, p.Title, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, p.Price, p.Location, 
               p.Description, p.Status, p.DateAdded, c.FullName AS ClientName, e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               p.min_price, p.max_price, p.avg_price, p.min_area, p.max_area, p.avg_area,
               p.governorate, p.district, p.detailed_address, p.company_name,
               p.sales_manager, p.sales_manager_phone, p.sales_responsible, p.sales_responsible_phone,
               p.company_phone, p.company_address, p.project_url, p.notes
        FROM Properties p
        LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
        LEFT JOIN Clients c ON p.ClientID = c.ClientID
        LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID"';

if ($sql_query_position !== false) {
    $sql_query_end_position = strpos($original_content, 'FROM Properties p', $sql_query_position);

                            }

                        <td><?php echo htmlspecialchars($property[\'district\'] ?: ($property[\'governorate\'] ?: \'N/A\')); ?></td>

#!/bin/bash

# Script to add session_check.php to all protected PHP pages
# This script will add the session check include after the translation include

PROTECTED_PAGES=(
    "add_client.php"
    "add_coastal_property.php"
    "add_employee.php"
    "add_other_property.php"
    "add_residential_property.php"
    "coastal_properties.php"
    "commercial_properties.php"
    "delete_client.php"
    "delete_employee.php"
    "edit_client.php"
    "edit_employee.php"
    "employees.php"
    "navbar.php"
    "other_properties.php"
    "residential_properties.php"
    "view_client.php"
    "view_property.php"
    "clients.php"
)

for page in "${PROTECTED_PAGES[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "$page" ]; then
        echo "Updating $page..."
        
        # Check if session_check.php is already included
        if ! grep -q "session_check.php" "$page"; then
            # Find the line with translate.php include and add session_check after it
            if grep -q "translate.php" "$page"; then
                sed -i '/translate\.php/a require_once '\''session_check.php'\''; // Include session timeout check' "$page"
                echo "Added session check to $page"
            else
                echo "Warning: Could not find translate.php include in $page"
            fi
        else
            echo "$page already has session check included"
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: $page not found"
    fi
done

echo "Script completed."

<?php
session_start();
require_once 'db.php';

// Check if user is logged in
if (!isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) || $_SESSION["loggedin"] !== true) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Unauthorized']);
    exit;
}

// CSRF protection
if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || $_POST['csrf_token'] !== $_SESSION['csrf_token']) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'CSRF token mismatch']);
    exit;
}

// Check if property ID is provided
if (!isset($_POST['property_id']) || empty($_POST['property_id'])) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Property ID is required']);
    exit;
}

$property_id = intval($_POST['property_id']);
$upload_type = $_POST['upload_type'] ?? ''; // 'image' or 'audio'

// Validate upload type
if (!in_array($upload_type, ['image', 'audio'])) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid upload type']);
    exit;
}

// Create upload directories if they don't exist
$base_upload_dir = __DIR__ . '/uploads/';
$image_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'images/';
$audio_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'audio/';

if (!is_dir($base_upload_dir)) {
    mkdir($base_upload_dir, 0755, true);
}
if (!is_dir($image_dir)) {
    mkdir($image_dir, 0755, true);
}
if (!is_dir($audio_dir)) {
    mkdir($audio_dir, 0755, true);
}

// Handle file upload
if ($upload_type === 'image') {
    handleImageUpload($property_id, $image_dir, $conn);
} elseif ($upload_type === 'audio') {
    handleAudioUpload($property_id, $audio_dir, $conn);
}

function handleImageUpload($property_id, $upload_dir, $conn) {
    if (!isset($_FILES['image']) || $_FILES['image']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'No image file uploaded or upload error']);
        return;
    }

    $file = $_FILES['image'];
    $allowed_types = ['image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    $max_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB

    // Validate file type
    $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
    $mime_type = finfo_file($finfo, $file['tmp_name']);
    finfo_close($finfo);

    if (!in_array($mime_type, $allowed_types)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid image format. Only JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP are allowed.']);
        return;
    }

    // Validate file size
    if ($file['size'] > $max_size) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Image file size exceeds 10MB limit.']);
        return;
    }

    // Generate unique filename
    $extension = pathinfo($file['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
    $filename = 'property_' . $property_id . '_' . uniqid() . '.' . $extension;
    $file_path = $upload_dir . $filename;
    $relative_path = 'uploads/images/' . $filename;

    // Move uploaded file
    if (move_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'], $file_path)) {
        // Check if this is the first image (set as primary)
        $is_primary = false;
        $check_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ?";
        if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql)) {
            $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
            $stmt->execute();
            $result = $stmt->get_result();
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
            $is_primary = ($row['count'] == 0); // First image is primary
            $stmt->close();
        }

        // Insert into database
        $sql = "INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
        if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
            $stmt->bind_param("isi", $property_id, $relative_path, $is_primary);
            if ($stmt->execute()) {
                $image_id = $conn->insert_id;
                echo json_encode([
                    'success' => true, 
                    'message' => 'Image uploaded successfully',
                    'image_id' => $image_id,
                    'file_path' => $relative_path,
                    'is_primary' => $is_primary
                ]);
            } else {
                // Delete uploaded file if database insert fails
                unlink($file_path);
                http_response_code(500);
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database error: ' . $stmt->error]);
            }
            $stmt->close();
        } else {
            // Delete uploaded file if prepare fails
            unlink($file_path);
            http_response_code(500);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
        }
    } else {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to move uploaded file']);
    }
}

function handleAudioUpload($property_id, $upload_dir, $conn) {
    if (!isset($_FILES['audio']) || $_FILES['audio']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'No audio file uploaded or upload error']);
        return;
    }

    $file = $_FILES['audio'];
    // MODIFIED: Added M4A and MP4 MIME types
    $allowed_types = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp3', 'audio/wav', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/m4a', 'audio/mp4', 'video/mp4'];
    $max_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB

    // Validate file type
    $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
    $mime_type = finfo_file($finfo, $file['tmp_name']);
    finfo_close($finfo);

    if (!in_array($mime_type, $allowed_types)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        // MODIFIED: Updated the error message
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid audio format. Only MP3, WAV, OGG, and M4A are allowed.']);
        return;
    }

    // Validate file size
    if ($file['size'] > $max_size) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Audio file size exceeds 10MB limit.']);
        return;
    }

    // Generate unique filename
    $extension = pathinfo($file['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
    $filename = 'property_' . $property_id . '_audio_' . uniqid() . '.' . $extension;
    $file_path = $upload_dir . $filename;
    $relative_path = 'uploads/audio/' . $filename;

    // Move uploaded file
    if (move_uploaded_file($file['tmp_name'], $file_path)) {
        // Get audio duration (optional, requires getID3 library or similar)
        $duration = null; // You can implement duration detection here if needed

        // Insert into database
        $sql = "INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
        if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
            $stmt->bind_param("isi", $property_id, $relative_path, $duration);
            if ($stmt->execute()) {
                $note_id = $conn->insert_id;
                echo json_encode([
                    'success' => true, 
                    'message' => 'Audio uploaded successfully',
                    'note_id' => $note_id,
                    'file_path' => $relative_path,
                    'duration' => $duration
                ]);
            } else {
                // Delete uploaded file if database insert fails
                unlink($file_path);
                http_response_code(500);
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database error: ' . $stmt->error]);
            }
            $stmt->close();
        } else {
            // Delete uploaded file if prepare fails
            unlink($file_path);
            http_response_code(500);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
        }
    } else {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to move uploaded file']);
    }
}

               e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               pud.DesignName AS UnitDesignName, pft.FinishingName AS FinishingTypeName
        FROM Properties p
        LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
        LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
        LEFT JOIN PropertyUnitDesigns pud ON p.unit_design_id = pud.DesignID
        LEFT JOIN PropertyFinishingTypes pft ON p.finishing_type_id = pft.FinishingID
        WHERE p.PropertyID = ?";

if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);

            header("Location: index_properties.php");

    } else {
        // Error executing query

// Format price for display
function formatPrice($property)
{
    if (!empty($property['Price']) && is_numeric($property['Price'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['Price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($property['min_price']) && is_numeric($property['min_price']) && !empty($property['max_price']) && is_numeric($property['max_price'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['min_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($property['max_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($property['min_price']) && is_numeric($property['min_price'])) {
        return t('starts_from') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($property['min_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($property['max_price']) && is_numeric($property['max_price'])) {
        return t('up_to') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($property['max_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($property['avg_price']) && is_numeric($property['avg_price'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['avg_price']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency') . ' (' . t('average') . ')';
    }
    return t('price_not_specified');
}

// Format area for display
function formatArea($property)
{
    if (!empty($property['Area']) && is_numeric($property['Area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['Area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($property['min_area']) && is_numeric($property['min_area']) && !empty($property['max_area']) && is_numeric($property['max_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($property['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($property['min_area']) && is_numeric($property['min_area'])) {
        return t('starts_from') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($property['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($property['max_area']) && is_numeric($property['max_area'])) {
        return t('up_to') . ' ' . number_format(floatval($property['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($property['avg_area']) && is_numeric($property['avg_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($property['avg_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm') . ' (' . t('average') . ')';
    }
    return t('area_not_specified');
}

// Format payment terms
function formatPaymentTerms($property)
{
    $terms = [];
    
    if (!empty($property['down_payment_percentage']) && is_numeric($property['down_payment_percentage'])) {
        $terms[] = number_format($property['down_payment_percentage'], 0) . '% ' . t('down_payment_percentage');
    }
    
    if (!empty($property['payment_years']) && is_numeric($property['payment_years'])) {
        $terms[] = $property['payment_years'] . ' ' . t('years');
    }
    
    return !empty($terms) ? implode(' + ', $terms) : t('undefined');
}

============================================================
FILE: lang/translate.php
============================================================
<?php
// lang/translate.php
if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Set default language if not set
if (!isset($_SESSION['lang'])) {
    $_SESSION['lang'] = 'ar'; // Default to Arabic as requested
}

// Handle language change request
if (isset($_GET['lang'])) {
    $lang = $_GET['lang'];
    if ($lang == 'en' || $lang == 'ar') {
        $_SESSION['lang'] = $lang;
        // Redirect back to the same page without the lang parameter to avoid issues on refresh/form submission
        $current_page = basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
        $query_params = $_GET;
        unset($query_params['lang']);
        $redirect_url = $current_page . (!empty($query_params) ? '?' . http_build_query($query_params) : '');
        header("Location: " . $redirect_url);
        exit();
    }
}

// Load the selected language file
$lang_file = __DIR__ . '/' . $_SESSION['lang'] . '.php';
if (file_exists($lang_file)) {
    $translations = include($lang_file);
} else {
    // Fallback to Arabic if language file not found
    $translations = include(__DIR__ . '/ar.php');
}

// Translation function
function t($key)
{
    global $translations;
    return isset($translations[$key]) ? $translations[$key] : $key; // Return key if translation not found
}

// Function to get current language direction
function get_direction()
{
    return ($_SESSION['lang'] == 'ar') ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
}

// Function to get current language code
function get_lang_code()
{
    return $_SESSION['lang'];
}

// Build and execute dynamic insert per demo entry to avoid column/placeholder mismatches
try {
    $conn->begin_transaction();
    foreach ($demo as $d) {
        // Prepare columns and values dynamically
        $cols = array_keys($d);
        $vals = array_values($d);

        // Append DateAdded as NOW()
        $colsSql = implode(', ', $cols) . ', DateAdded';

        $placeholders = implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($vals), '?')) . ', NOW()';

        $sql = "INSERT INTO Properties ({$colsSql}) VALUES ({$placeholders})";
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql);

        // Build types string
        $types = '';
        $bindVars = [];
        foreach ($vals as $v) {
            if (is_int($v)) { $types .= 'i'; }
            elseif (is_float($v)) { $types .= 'd'; }
            else { $types .= 's'; }
            // Ensure NULLs are passed as null variables
            $bindVars[] = $v;
        }

        // Call safe_bind_param with dynamic types
        $callArgs = array_merge([$stmt, $types], $bindVars);
        // Use call_user_func_array to forward arguments to safe_bind_param
        call_user_func_array('safe_bind_param', $callArgs);
        $stmt->execute();
        $id = $conn->insert_id;
        echo "Inserted property ID: $id\n";

        // Create placeholder media files and insert rows
        $baseDir = __DIR__ . '/../uploads/';
        @mkdir($baseDir . 'images/', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($baseDir . 'audio/', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($baseDir . 'videos/', 0755, true);

        $imgName = 'property_' . $id . '_placeholder.jpg';
        file_put_contents($baseDir . 'images/' . $imgName, 'placeholder');
        $imgRel = 'uploads/images/' . $imgName;
        $insImg = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        $is_primary = 1;
        $insImg->bind_param("isi", $id, $imgRel, $is_primary);
        $insImg->execute();
        $insImg->close();

        $vidName = 'property_' . $id . '_placeholder.mp4';
        file_put_contents($baseDir . 'videos/' . $vidName, 'placeholder');
        $vidRel = 'uploads/videos/' . $vidName;
        $insVid = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO property_videos (PropertyID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, EmployeeID) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
        $vsize = filesize($baseDir . 'videos/' . $vidName);
        $emp = 1;
        $insVid->bind_param("issii", $id, $vidRel, $vidName, $vsize, $emp);
        $insVid->execute();
        $insVid->close();

        $audName = 'property_' . $id . '_placeholder.mp3';
        file_put_contents($baseDir . 'audio/' . $audName, 'placeholder');
        $audRel = 'uploads/audio/' . $audName;
        $insAud = $conn->prepare("INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        $dur = null;
        $insAud->bind_param("isi", $id, $audRel, $dur);
        $insAud->execute();
        $insAud->close();
    }
    $conn->commit();
    echo "Seeding completed.\n";
} catch (Exception $e) {
    $conn->rollback();
    echo "Error: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . 
'/lang/translate.php'; // Translation handler
require_once 'permissions.php'; // Include permissions system
require_once 'session_check.php'; // Include session timeout check
require_once __DIR__ . '/db.php'; // Database connection
require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';

ensure_secure_session_started();

// Check permissions - only manager and admin can add properties
check_permission('manage_properties');

// Ensure a CSRF token variable is available for the form/uploader
$csrf_token = generateCSRFToken();

// Enforce mode selection - redirect to dashboard if no mode is set
if (!isset($_SESSION['listing_context']) || ($_SESSION['listing_context'] !== 'Primary' && $_SESSION['listing_context'] !== 'Resale')) {
    header('Location: dashboard.php');
    exit();
}

$current_mode = $_SESSION['listing_context'];

// --- Fetch Lookups (Similar to add_residential) ---
$property_types = [];
$unit_designs = [];
$finishing_types = [];
$employees = [];

// Fetch Property Types (Filter for Coastal Type = 2 - Assuming 2 is Coastal)
$sql_types = "SELECT PropertyTypeID, TypeName FROM PropertyTypes WHERE PropertyTypeID = 2";
if ($result = $conn->query($sql_types)) {
    while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
        $property_types[] = $row;
    }
    $result->free();
} else {
    error_log("Error fetching coastal property types: " . $conn->error);
}

// Unit designs are now handled as text input, no database lookup needed

// Fetch Finishing Types
$sql_finishing = "SELECT FinishingID, FinishingName, FinishingName_ar FROM propertyfinishingtypes ORDER BY FinishingID";
if ($result = $conn->query($sql_finishing)) {
    while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
        $finishing_types[] = $row;
    }
    $result->free();
} else {
    error_log("Error fetching finishing types: " . $conn->error);
}

// Fetch Employees
$sql_employees = "SELECT EmployeeID, FullName FROM employees ORDER BY FullName";
if ($result = $conn->query($sql_employees)) {
    while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
        $employees[] = $row;
    }
    $result->free();
} else {
    error_log("Error fetching employees: " . $conn->error);
}

$errors = [];
$success_message = '';

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    if (!validateCSRFToken($_POST['csrf_token'] ?? null)) {
        $errors[] = t('invalid_csrf_token');
    }
    // --- Data Sanitization ---
    $property_type_id = 2; // Hardcoded for Coastal
    $listing_type = $_SESSION['listing_context'] ?? 'Primary';

    $title = trim($_POST['title'] ?? '');
    $description = trim($_POST['description'] ?? null);
    $governorate = trim($_POST['governorate'] ?? '');
    $district = trim($_POST['district'] ?? '');

    $company_name = trim($_POST['company_name'] ?? null);
    $compound_area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'compound_area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $floors_count = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'floors_count', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $unit_design = trim($_POST['unit_design'] ?? '');
    $min_area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'min_area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $max_area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'max_area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $avg_area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'avg_area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $bedrooms = null; // Bedrooms field removed from this form
    // Bathrooms column removed from schema
    $finishing_type_id = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'finishing_type_id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);

    $down_payment_percentage = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'down_payment_percentage', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    // Allow fractional years (e.g. 1.5). Use float validation and keep NULL when not provided
    $payment_years = null;
    if (isset($_POST['payment_years']) && trim($_POST['payment_years']) !== '') {
        $payment_years = filter_var($_POST['payment_years'], FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT);
    }
    $delivery_date_str = trim($_POST['delivery_date'] ?? '');
    $status = trim($_POST['status'] ?? 'available');

    $salesperson_phone = trim($_POST['salesperson_phone'] ?? null);
    $delivery_date = !empty($delivery_date_str) ? $delivery_date_str : null;
    
    // New Phase 2 fields
    $year_built = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'year_built', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    // Normalize year_built: accept only reasonable years, otherwise set null to avoid storing 0/0000
    if ($year_built !== null) {
        $year_int = intval($year_built);
        $current_year = intval(date('Y'));
        if ($year_int < 1900 || $year_int > ($current_year + 1)) {
            $year_built = null;
        } else {
            $year_built = $year_int;
        }
    }
    $unit_floor = trim($_POST['unit_floor'] ?? null);
    $net_area = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'net_area', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $loading_percentage = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'loading_percentage', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);

    $meter_price_cash = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'meter_price_cash', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $meter_price_installments = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'meter_price_installments', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);
    $seller_type = trim($_POST['seller_type'] ?? '');
    if ($seller_type === '') { $seller_type = null; }
    if ($seller_type !== null && !in_array($seller_type, allowed_seller_types(), true)) {
        $seller_type = normalize_seller_type_for_db($conn, $seller_type);
    }
    $seller_name = trim($_POST['seller_name'] ?? null);
    $seller_phone = trim($_POST['seller_phone'] ?? null);

    $sql = "INSERT INTO Properties (PropertyTypeID, Title, Description, Location, Area, Bedrooms, Status, listing_type, EmployeeID, unit_design, finishing_type_id, compound_area, down_payment_percentage, payment_years, delivery_date, ProjectName, min_area, max_area, avg_area, district, governorate, company_name, FloorsCount, sales_manager_name, sales_manager_phone, salesperson_name, salesperson_phone, year_built, unit_floor, net_area, loading_percentage, price_cash, price_installments, meter_price_cash, meter_price_installments, seller_type, seller_name, seller_phone, DateAdded) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())";

    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        // Build bind-vars and types dynamically (ensures floats like payment_years become 'd')
        $bind_vars = [
            $property_type_id, $title, $description, $location, $area, $bedrooms, $status, $listing_type, $employee_id, $unit_design, $finishing_type_id, $compound_area, $down_payment_percentage, $payment_years, $delivery_date, $project_name, $min_area, $max_area, $avg_area, $district, $governorate, $company_name, $floors_count, $sales_manager_name, $sales_manager_phone, $salesperson_name, $salesperson_phone, $year_built, $unit_floor, $net_area, $loading_percentage, $price_cash, $price_installments, $meter_price_cash, $meter_price_installments, $seller_type, $seller_name, $seller_phone
        ];

        $types = '';
        foreach ($bind_vars as $bv) {
            if (is_int($bv)) {
                $types .= 'i';
            } elseif (is_float($bv)) {
                $types .= 'd';
            } elseif (is_numeric($bv)) {
                $types .= (strpos((string)$bv, '.') !== false) ? 'd' : 'i';
            } else {
                $types .= 's';
            }
        }

        $params = array_merge([$stmt, $types], $bind_vars);
        call_user_func_array('safe_bind_param', $params);

    // Debug: log key fields before execute to help diagnose missing storage
    error_log("DEBUG add_coastal_property: year_built=" . var_export($year_built, true) . " seller_type=" . var_export($seller_type, true));
    if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $new_property_id = $conn->insert_id;

            // Handle optional media uploads (same as residential)
            $base_upload_dir = __DIR__ . '/uploads/';
            $image_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'images/';
            $audio_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'audio/';
            if (!is_dir($base_upload_dir)) { mkdir($base_upload_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($image_dir)) { mkdir($image_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($audio_dir)) { mkdir($audio_dir, 0755, true); }

            // Images
            if (!empty($_FILES['images']) && is_array($_FILES['images']['name'])) {
                $is_first_image = true;
                $check_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ?";
                if ($check_stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql)) {
                    $check_stmt->bind_param("i", $new_property_id);
                    $check_stmt->execute();
                    $res = $check_stmt->get_result();
                    if ($row = $res->fetch_assoc()) { $is_first_image = ($row['count'] == 0); }
                    $check_stmt->close();
                }

                $allowed_img_mime = ['image/jpeg' => 'jpg', 'image/jpg' => 'jpg', 'image/png' => 'png', 'image/webp' => 'webp'];
                $max_img_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['images']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['images']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['images']['size'][$idx] > $max_img_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['images']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_img_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_img_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $image_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/images/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $is_primary = $is_first_image ? 1 : 0;
                        $is_first_image = false;
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($img_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $img_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $is_primary);
                            $img_stmt->execute();
                            $img_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo);
            }

            // Audio
            if (!empty($_FILES['audio']) && is_array($_FILES['audio']['name'])) {
                $allowed_audio_mime = ['audio/mpeg' => 'mp3', 'audio/mp3' => 'mp3', 'audio/wav' => 'wav', 'audio/ogg' => 'ogg', 'audio/m4a' => 'm4a', 'audio/mp4' => 'm4a', 'video/mp4' => 'm4a'];
                $max_audio_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo2 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['audio']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['size'][$idx] > $max_audio_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['audio']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo2, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_audio_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_audio_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_audio_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $audio_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/audio/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        $duration = null;
                        if ($aud_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $aud_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $duration);
                            $aud_stmt->execute();
                            $aud_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo2);
            }

            // Videos (same implementation as residential)
            if (!empty($_FILES['videos']) && is_array($_FILES['videos']['name'])) {
                $allowed_video_mime = [
                    'video/mp4' => 'mp4', 'video/webm' => 'webm', 'video/ogg' => 'ogv',
                    'video/avi' => 'avi', 'video/quicktime' => 'mov', 'video/x-ms-wmv' => 'wmv', 'video/x-flv' => 'flv'
                ];
                $max_video_size = 250 * 1024 * 1024; // 250MB
                $finfo3 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['videos']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['size'][$idx] > $max_video_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['videos']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo3, $tmp);
                    $ext = pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
                    if (isset($allowed_video_mime[$mime])) {
                        $ext = $allowed_video_mime[$mime];
                    }
                    if (empty($ext)) {
                        error_log('Skipping video (no extension/mime): ' . $name . ' mime=' . $mime);
                        continue;
                    }
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_video_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $base_upload_dir . 'videos/' . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/videos/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $employee_id = $_SESSION['employee_id'] ?? 0;
                        $emp_id_int = (int)$employee_id;
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_videos (PropertyID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, EmployeeID) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($vstmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $videoSize = filesize($dest);
                            $vstmt->bind_param("issii", $new_property_id, $relative, $name, $videoSize, $emp_id_int);
                            $vstmt->execute();
                            $vstmt->close();
                        }
                    } else {
                        error_log('Failed to move uploaded video file ' . $tmp . ' to ' . $dest);
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo3);
            }

            // Move any temporary uploads (uploaded before saving the property) into this property
            if (function_exists('moveTempUploadsToProperty')) {
                $moved = moveTempUploadsToProperty($new_property_id, session_id(), $conn);
                error_log('Moved temp uploads for session ' . session_id() . ': ' . json_encode($moved));
            }

            // Use robust flash helper and set legacy session key for compatibility (mirror edit behavior)
            require_once __DIR__ . '/flash.php';
            if (function_exists('add_flash')) { add_flash(t('property_added_success'), 6); }
            // session is written before redirect
            session_write_close(); // Force session data to be saved now
            header("Location: view_property.php?id=" . $new_property_id . "&added=1");
            exit();
        } else {
            error_log("DB Error (add_coastal_property): " . $stmt->error);
            $errors[] = t('database_error') . ': ' . $stmt->error;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        error_log("DB Prepare Error (add_coastal_property): " . $conn->error);
        $errors[] = t('database_error');
    }
}

                </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sales Information Section -->
        <div class="form-section">
            <h3><?php echo t("sales_information"); ?></h3>
            <div class="form-grid">
                <div>
                    <label for="sales_manager_name"><?php echo t("sales_manager_name_label"); ?></label>
                    <input type="text" id="sales_manager_name" name="sales_manager_name" class="form-input" value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_POST["sales_manager_name"] ?? ""); ?>">
                </div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Image upload functionality
    const imageUploadArea = document.getElementById('image-upload-area');
    const imageUploadBtn = document.getElementById('image-upload-btn');
    const imageUploadInput = document.getElementById('image-upload');
    const imagePreview = document.getElementById('image-preview');
    const imageThumbnails = document.getElementById('image-thumbnails');
    
    // Audio upload functionality
    const audioUploadArea = document.getElementById('audio-upload-area');
    const audioUploadBtn = document.getElementById('audio-upload-btn');
    const audioUploadInput = document.getElementById('audio-upload');
    const audioPreview = document.getElementById('audio-preview');
    const audioList = document.getElementById('audio-list');
    
    let selectedImages = [];
    let selectedAudio = [];
    
    // Image upload button click
    imageUploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        imageUploadInput.click();
    });
    
    // Audio upload button click
    audioUploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        audioUploadInput.click();
    });
    
    // Image file selection
    imageUploadInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        handleImageFiles(e.target.files);
    });
    
    // Audio file selection
    audioUploadInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        handleAudioFiles(e.target.files);
    });
    
    // Image drag and drop
    imageUploadArea.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        imageUploadArea.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    
    imageUploadArea.addEventListener('dragleave', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        imageUploadArea.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    
    imageUploadArea.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        imageUploadArea.classList.remove('dragover');
        handleImageFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
    });
    
    // Audio drag and drop
    audioUploadArea.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        audioUploadArea.classList.add('dragover');
    });
    
    audioUploadArea.addEventListener('dragleave', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        audioUploadArea.classList.remove('dragover');
    });
    
    audioUploadArea.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        audioUploadArea.classList.remove('dragover');
        handleAudioFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
    });
    
    function handleImageFiles(files) {
        const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
        const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
        
        Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
            if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
                alert('Invalid file type: ' + file.name + '. Please select JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP files.');
                return;
            }
            
            if (file.size > maxSize) {
                alert('File too large: ' + file.name + '. Maximum size is 10MB.');
                return;
            }
            
            selectedImages.push(file);
        });
        
        updateImagePreview();
        updateImageInput();
    }
    
    function handleAudioFiles(files) {
        const allowedTypes = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp3', 'audio/wav', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/m4a'];
        const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB
        
        Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
            if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
                alert('Invalid file type: ' + file.name + '. Please select MP3, WAV, OGG, or M4A files.');
                return;
            }
            
            if (file.size > maxSize) {
                alert('File too large: ' + file.name + '. Maximum size is 10MB.');
                return;
            }
            
            selectedAudio.push(file);
        });
        
        updateAudioPreview();
        updateAudioInput();
    }
    
    function updateImagePreview() {
        imageThumbnails.innerHTML = '';
        
        if (selectedImages.length > 0) {
            imagePreview.style.display = 'block';
            
            selectedImages.forEach((file, index) => {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(e) {
                    const div = document.createElement('div');
                    div.className = 'image-preview';
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <img src="${e.target.result}" alt="${file.name}">
                        <button type="button" class="remove-file" onclick="removeImage(${index})">×</button>
                    `;
                    imageThumbnails.appendChild(div);
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            });
        } else {
            imagePreview.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }
    
    function updateAudioPreview() {
        audioList.innerHTML = '';
        
        if (selectedAudio.length > 0) {
            audioPreview.style.display = 'block';
            
            selectedAudio.forEach((file, index) => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'audio-preview';
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <span>🎵 ${file.name}</span>
                    <button type="button" class="remove-file" onclick="removeAudio(${index})">×</button>
                `;
                audioList.appendChild(div);
            });
        } else {
            audioPreview.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }
    
    function updateImageInput() {
        const dt = new DataTransfer();
        selectedImages.forEach(file => dt.items.add(file));
        imageUploadInput.files = dt.files;
    }
    
    function updateAudioInput() {
        const dt = new DataTransfer();
        selectedAudio.forEach(file => dt.items.add(file));
        audioUploadInput.files = dt.files;
    }
    
    // Global functions for remove buttons
    window.removeImage = function(index) {
        selectedImages.splice(index, 1);
        updateImagePreview();
        updateImageInput();
    };
    
    window.removeAudio = function(index) {
        selectedAudio.splice(index, 1);
        updateAudioPreview();
        updateAudioInput();
    };
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Map initialization using Leaflet only
    let map;
    let marker;

    function initMap() {
        const defaultLat = 30.0444;
        const defaultLng = 31.2357;

        const latInput = document.getElementById('latitude');
        const lngInput = document.getElementById('longitude');
        const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value) || defaultLat;
        const lng = parseFloat(lngInput.value) || defaultLng;

        if (typeof L === 'undefined') {
            console.error('Leaflet is not loaded.');
            return;
        }

        map = L.map('map').setView([lat, lng], 10);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            maxZoom: 19,
            attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(map);

        if (!isNaN(parseFloat(latInput.value)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lngInput.value))) {
            marker = L.marker([lat, lng]).addTo(map);
        }

        map.on('click', function(e) {
            const clickedLat = e.latlng.lat;
            const clickedLng = e.latlng.lng;
            latInput.value = clickedLat;
            lngInput.value = clickedLng;
            if (marker) { map.removeLayer(marker); }
            marker = L.marker([clickedLat, clickedLng]).addTo(map);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('load', initMap);
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';
ensure_secure_session_started();
require_once 'session_check.php'; // Include session timeout check

// Session already ensured securely

// Check permissions - only manager can manage employees
check_permission("manage_employees");
require_once __DIR__ . 
'/db.php'; // Database connection

$full_name = $username = $password = $role = "";
$full_name_err = $username_err = $password_err = $role_err = $general_err = "";

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    if (!validateCSRFToken($_POST['csrf_token'] ?? null)) {
        $general_err = t('invalid_csrf_token');
    }
    // Validate Full Name
    if (empty(trim($_POST["fullName"]))) {
        $full_name_err = "Please enter the employee's full name.";
    } else {
        $full_name = trim($_POST["fullName"]);
    }

    // Validate Username
    if (empty(trim($_POST["username"]))) {
        $username_err = "Please enter a username.";
    } elseif (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', trim($_POST["username"]))) {
        $username_err = "Username can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.";
    } else {
        // Check if username already exists
        $sql_check_username = "SELECT EmployeeID FROM Employees WHERE Username = ?";
        if ($stmt_check = $conn->prepare($sql_check_username)) {
            $stmt_check->bind_param("s", $param_username_check);
            $param_username_check = trim($_POST["username"]);
            if ($stmt_check->execute()) {
                $stmt_check->store_result();
                if ($stmt_check->num_rows > 0) {
                    $username_err = "This username is already taken.";
                }
                $username = trim($_POST["username"]);
            } else {
                $general_err = "Error checking username. Please try again.";
                error_log("Error executing username check: " . $stmt_check->error);
            }
            $stmt_check->close();
        } else {
            $general_err = "Database error (username check). Please try again.";
            error_log("Error preparing username check: " . $conn->error);
        }
    }

    // Validate Password
    if (empty($_POST["password"])) {
        $password_err = "Please enter a password.";
    } elseif (strlen($_POST["password"]) < 6) {
        $password_err = "Password must have at least 6 characters.";
    } else {
        $password = $_POST["password"];
    }

    // Validate Role
    if (empty($_POST["role"])) {
        $role_err = "Please select a role.";
    } elseif (!in_array($_POST["role"], ["admin", "user", "manager"])) {
        $role_err = "Invalid role selected.";
    } else {
        $role = $_POST["role"];
    }

    // Check input errors before inserting in database
    if (empty($full_name_err) && empty($username_err) && empty($password_err) && empty($role_err) && empty($general_err)) {
        // Hash the password
        $hashed_password = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO Employees (FullName, Username, Password, Role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
            $stmt->bind_param("ssss", $param_full_name, $param_username, $param_hashed_password, $param_role);
            
            $param_full_name = $full_name;
            $param_username = $username;
            $param_hashed_password = $hashed_password;
            $param_role = $role;
            
            if ($stmt->execute()) {
                require_once __DIR__ . '/flash.php';
                if (function_exists('add_flash')) { add_flash("Employee added successfully!", 6); }
                header("Location: employees_list.php"); // Redirect to employees list or dashboard
                exit();
            } else {
                $general_err = "Something went wrong. Please try again later.";
                error_log("Error executing employee insert: " . $stmt->error);
            }
            $stmt->close();
        }
    }
}

    $longitude = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'longitude', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);

    $sql = "INSERT INTO Properties (PropertyTypeID, Title, Description, Location, Area, Bedrooms, Status, listing_type, EmployeeID, unit_design, finishing_type_id, compound_area, down_payment_percentage, payment_years, delivery_date, ProjectName, min_area, max_area, avg_area, district, governorate, company_name, FloorsCount, sales_manager_name, sales_manager_phone, salesperson_name, salesperson_phone, year_built, unit_floor, net_area, loading_percentage, price_cash, price_installments, meter_price_cash, meter_price_installments, seller_type, seller_name, seller_phone, latitude, longitude, DateAdded) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())";

    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        // Build bind-vars and types dynamically to preserve decimal types (payment_years)
        $bind_vars = [
            $property_type_id, $title, $description, $location, $area, $bedrooms, $status, $listing_type, $employee_id, $unit_design, $finishing_type_id, $compound_area, $down_payment_percentage, $payment_years, $delivery_date, $project_name, $min_area, $max_area, $avg_area, $district, $governorate, $company_name, $floors_count, $sales_manager_name, $sales_manager_phone, $salesperson_name, $salesperson_phone, $year_built, $unit_floor, $net_area, $loading_percentage, $price_cash, $price_installments, $meter_price_cash, $meter_price_installments, $seller_type, $seller_name, $seller_phone, $latitude, $longitude
        ];

        $types = '';
        foreach ($bind_vars as $bv) {
            if (is_int($bv)) {
                $types .= 'i';
            } elseif (is_float($bv)) {
                $types .= 'd';
            } elseif (is_numeric($bv)) {
                $types .= (strpos((string)$bv, '.') !== false) ? 'd' : 'i';
            } else {
                $types .= 's';
            }
        }

        $params = array_merge([$stmt, $types], $bind_vars);
        call_user_func_array('safe_bind_param', $params);

    // Debug: log key fields before execute to help diagnose missing storage
    error_log("DEBUG add_other_property: year_built=" . var_export($year_built, true) . " seller_type=" . var_export($seller_type, true));
    if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $new_property_id = $conn->insert_id;

            // Handle optional media uploads (same logic)
            $base_upload_dir = __DIR__ . '/uploads/';
            $image_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'images/';
            $audio_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'audio/';
            if (!is_dir($base_upload_dir)) { mkdir($base_upload_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($image_dir)) { mkdir($image_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($audio_dir)) { mkdir($audio_dir, 0755, true); }

            // Images
            if (!empty($_FILES['images']) && is_array($_FILES['images']['name'])) {
                $is_first_image = true;
                $check_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ?";
                if ($check_stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql)) {
                    $check_stmt->bind_param("i", $new_property_id);
                    $check_stmt->execute();
                    $res = $check_stmt->get_result();
                    if ($row = $res->fetch_assoc()) { $is_first_image = ($row['count'] == 0); }
                    $check_stmt->close();
                }

                $allowed_img_mime = ['image/jpeg' => 'jpg', 'image/jpg' => 'jpg', 'image/png' => 'png', 'image/webp' => 'webp'];
                $max_img_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['images']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['images']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['images']['size'][$idx] > $max_img_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['images']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_img_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_img_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $image_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/images/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $is_primary = $is_first_image ? 1 : 0;
                        $is_first_image = false;
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($img_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $img_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $is_primary);
                            $img_stmt->execute();
                            $img_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo);
            }

            // Audio
            if (!empty($_FILES['audio']) && is_array($_FILES['audio']['name'])) {
                $allowed_audio_mime = ['audio/mpeg' => 'mp3', 'audio/mp3' => 'mp3', 'audio/wav' => 'wav', 'audio/ogg' => 'ogg', 'audio/m4a' => 'm4a', 'audio/mp4' => 'm4a', 'video/mp4' => 'm4a'];
                $max_audio_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo2 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['audio']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['size'][$idx] > $max_audio_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['audio']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo2, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_audio_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_audio_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_audio_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $audio_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/audio/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        $duration = null;
                        if ($aud_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $aud_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $duration);
                            $aud_stmt->execute();
                            $aud_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo2);
            }

            // Videos
            if (!empty($_FILES['videos']) && is_array($_FILES['videos']['name'])) {
                $allowed_video_mime = [
                    'video/mp4' => 'mp4', 'video/webm' => 'webm', 'video/ogg' => 'ogv',
                    'video/avi' => 'avi', 'video/quicktime' => 'mov', 'video/x-ms-wmv' => 'wmv', 'video/x-flv' => 'flv'
                ];
                $max_video_size = 250 * 1024 * 1024; // 250MB
                $finfo3 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['videos']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['size'][$idx] > $max_video_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['videos']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo3, $tmp);
                    $ext = pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
                    if (isset($allowed_video_mime[$mime])) {
                        $ext = $allowed_video_mime[$mime];
                    }
                    if (empty($ext)) {
                        error_log('Skipping video (no extension/mime): ' . $name . ' mime=' . $mime);
                        continue;
                    }
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_video_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $base_upload_dir . 'videos/' . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/videos/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $employee_id = $_SESSION['employee_id'] ?? 0;
                        $emp_id_int = (int)$employee_id;
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_videos (PropertyID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, EmployeeID) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($vstmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $videoSize = filesize($dest);
                            $vstmt->bind_param("issii", $new_property_id, $relative, $name, $videoSize, $emp_id_int);
                            $vstmt->execute();
                            $vstmt->close();
                        }
                    } else {
                        error_log('Failed to move uploaded video file ' . $tmp . ' to ' . $dest);
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo3);
            }

            // Move any temporary uploads into property
            if (function_exists('moveTempUploadsToProperty')) {
                $moved = moveTempUploadsToProperty($new_property_id, session_id(), $conn);
                error_log('Moved temp uploads for session ' . session_id() . ': ' . json_encode($moved));
            }

            // Use robust flash helper and set legacy session key for compatibility (mirror edit behavior)
            require_once __DIR__ . '/flash.php';
            if (function_exists('add_flash')) { add_flash(t('property_added_success'), 6); }
            // session is written before redirect
            session_write_close(); // Force session data to be saved now
            header("Location: view_property.php?id=" . $new_property_id . "&added=1");
            exit();
        } else {
            error_log("DB Error (add_other_property): " . $stmt->error);
            $errors[] = t('database_error') . ': ' . $stmt->error;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        error_log("DB Prepare Error (add_other_property): " . $conn->error);
        $errors[] = t('database_error');
    }
}

                    <input type="number" step="0.01" id="price_installments" name="price_installments" class="form-input" value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_POST['price_installments'] ?? ''); ?>">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="meter_price_cash"><?php echo t('meter_price_cash'); ?>:</label>
                    <input type="number" step="0.01" id="meter_price_cash" name="meter_price_cash" class="form-input" value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_POST['meter_price_cash'] ?? ''); ?>">

                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="payment_years"><?php echo t('payment_years'); ?>:</label>
                    <input type="number" step="0.5" min="0.5" id="payment_years" name="payment_years" class="form-input" value="<?php echo isset($_POST['payment_years']) ? htmlspecialchars($_POST['payment_years']) : ''; ?>" placeholder="مثال: 1.5 للسنة والنصف">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="delivery_date"><?php echo t('delivery_date'); ?>:</label>
                    <input type="date" id="delivery_date" name="delivery_date" class="form-input" value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_POST['delivery_date'] ?? ''); ?>">
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
    <h3><?php echo t('additional_info'); ?></h3>
    <div class="form-grid">
