<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Initialize interactive map using Leaflet only
    let map;
    let marker;

    function initMap() {
        const defaultLat = 30.0444;
        const defaultLng = 31.2357;

        const latInput = document.getElementById('latitude');
        const lngInput = document.getElementById('longitude');
        const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value) || defaultLat;
        const lng = parseFloat(lngInput.value) || defaultLng;

        if (typeof L === 'undefined') {
            console.error('Leaflet is not loaded.');
            return;
        }

        map = L.map('map').setView([lat, lng], 10);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            maxZoom: 19,
            attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(map);

        if (!isNaN(parseFloat(latInput.value)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lngInput.value))) {
            marker = L.marker([lat, lng]).addTo(map);
        }

        map.on('click', function(e) {
            const clickedLat = e.latlng.lat;
            const clickedLng = e.latlng.lng;

            latInput.value = clickedLat;
            lngInput.value = clickedLng;

            if (marker) { map.removeLayer(marker); }
            marker = L.marker([clickedLat, clickedLng]).addTo(map);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('load', initMap);
});
</script>

</body>

    if ($year_built !== null) {

        if ($year_int < 1900 || $year_int > ($current_year + 1)) {
            $year_built = null;

    $meter_price_cash = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'meter_price_cash', FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE);

    if ($seller_type === '') { $seller_type = null; }

            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())";

    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        // Dynamically build types string from variable values to avoid manual mismatch
        $bind_vars = [
            $property_type_id, $title, $description, $location, $area, $bedrooms, $status, $listing_type, $employee_id, $unit_design, $finishing_type_id, $compound_area, $down_payment_percentage, $payment_years, $delivery_date, $project_name, $min_area, $max_area, $avg_area, $district, $governorate, $company_name, $floors_count, $sales_manager_name, $sales_manager_phone, $salesperson_name, $salesperson_phone, $year_built, $unit_floor, $net_area, $loading_percentage, $price_cash, $price_installments, $meter_price_cash, $meter_price_installments, $seller_type, $seller_name, $seller_phone, $latitude, $longitude
        ];

        // Build types string: i for integers, d for floats, s for everything else
        $types = '';
        foreach ($bind_vars as $bv) {
            if (is_int($bv)) {
                $types .= 'i';
            } elseif (is_float($bv)) {
                $types .= 'd';
            } elseif (is_numeric($bv)) {
                // numeric string: decide based on presence of decimal point
                $types .= (strpos((string)$bv, '.') !== false) ? 'd' : 'i';
            } else {
                $types .= 's';
            }
        }

        // Prepare parameters for safe_bind_param: stmt, types, then values
        $params = array_merge([$stmt, $types], $bind_vars);
        call_user_func_array('safe_bind_param', $params);

    // Debug: log key fields before execute to help diagnose missing storage
    error_log("DEBUG add_residential_property: year_built=" . var_export($year_built, true) . " seller_type=" . var_export($seller_type, true));
    if ($stmt->execute()) {
            $new_property_id = $conn->insert_id;

            // Handle optional media uploads
            $base_upload_dir = __DIR__ . '/uploads/';
            $image_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'images/';
            $audio_dir = $base_upload_dir . 'audio/';
            if (!is_dir($base_upload_dir)) { mkdir($base_upload_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($image_dir)) { mkdir($image_dir, 0755, true); }
            if (!is_dir($audio_dir)) { mkdir($audio_dir, 0755, true); }

            // Images
            if (!empty($_FILES['images']) && is_array($_FILES['images']['name'])) {
                // Determine if any existing images for this property
                $is_first_image = true;
                $check_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ?";
                if ($check_stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql)) {
                    $check_stmt->bind_param("i", $new_property_id);
                    $check_stmt->execute();
                    $res = $check_stmt->get_result();
                    if ($row = $res->fetch_assoc()) { $is_first_image = ($row['count'] == 0); }
                    $check_stmt->close();
                }

                $allowed_img_mime = ['image/jpeg' => 'jpg', 'image/jpg' => 'jpg', 'image/png' => 'png', 'image/webp' => 'webp'];
                $max_img_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['images']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['images']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['images']['size'][$idx] > $max_img_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['images']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_img_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_img_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $image_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/images/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $is_primary = $is_first_image ? 1 : 0;
                        $is_first_image = false;
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($img_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $img_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $is_primary);
                            $img_stmt->execute();
                            $img_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo);
            }

            // Audio
            if (!empty($_FILES['audio']) && is_array($_FILES['audio']['name'])) {
                $allowed_audio_mime = ['audio/mpeg' => 'mp3', 'audio/mp3' => 'mp3', 'audio/wav' => 'wav', 'audio/ogg' => 'ogg', 'audio/m4a' => 'm4a', 'audio/mp4' => 'm4a', 'video/mp4' => 'm4a'];
                $max_audio_size = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
                $finfo2 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['audio']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['audio']['size'][$idx] > $max_audio_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['audio']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo2, $tmp);
                    if (!isset($allowed_audio_mime[$mime])) { continue; }
                    $ext = $allowed_audio_mime[$mime];
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_audio_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $audio_dir . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/audio/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                        $duration = null;
                        if ($aud_stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $aud_stmt->bind_param("isi", $new_property_id, $relative, $duration);
                            $aud_stmt->execute();
                            $aud_stmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo2);
            }

            // Videos
            if (!empty($_FILES['videos']) && is_array($_FILES['videos']['name'])) {
                $allowed_video_mime = [
                    'video/mp4' => 'mp4', 'video/webm' => 'webm', 'video/ogg' => 'ogv',
                    'video/avi' => 'avi', 'video/quicktime' => 'mov', 'video/x-ms-wmv' => 'wmv', 'video/x-flv' => 'flv'
                ];
                $max_video_size = 250 * 1024 * 1024; // 250MB
                $finfo3 = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
                foreach ($_FILES['videos']['name'] as $idx => $name) {
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['error'][$idx] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { continue; }
                    if ($_FILES['videos']['size'][$idx] > $max_video_size) { continue; }
                    $tmp = $_FILES['videos']['tmp_name'][$idx];
                    $mime = finfo_file($finfo3, $tmp);
                    // Allow if mime is known or fallback to extension
                    $ext = pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
                    // prefer extension inferred from mime if available
                    if (isset($allowed_video_mime[$mime])) {
                        $ext = $allowed_video_mime[$mime];
                    }
                    if (empty($ext)) {
                        error_log('Skipping video (no extension/mime): ' . $name . ' mime=' . $mime);
                        continue;
                    }
                    $filename = 'property_' . $new_property_id . '_video_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
                    $dest = $base_upload_dir . 'videos/' . $filename;
                    $relative = 'uploads/videos/' . $filename;
                    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dest)) {
                        $employee_id = $_SESSION['employee_id'] ?? 0;
                        $emp_id_int = (int)$employee_id; // ensure a variable (not an expression) is passed by reference to bind_param
                        $ins = "INSERT INTO property_videos (PropertyID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, EmployeeID) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
                        if ($vstmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                            $videoSize = filesize($dest);
                            $vstmt->bind_param("issii", $new_property_id, $relative, $name, $videoSize, $emp_id_int);
                            $vstmt->execute();
                            if ($vstmt->affected_rows > 0) {
                                error_log('Inserted video for property ' . $new_property_id . ' => ' . $relative);
                            } else {
                                error_log('Failed to insert video DB row for ' . $relative . ': ' . $vstmt->error);
                            }
                            $vstmt->close();
                        }
                    }
                    else {
                        error_log('Failed to move uploaded video file ' . $tmp . ' to ' . $dest);
                    }
                }
                finfo_close($finfo3);
            }

            // Move any temporary uploads (uploaded before saving the property) into this property
            if (function_exists('moveTempUploadsToProperty')) {
                $moved = moveTempUploadsToProperty($new_property_id, session_id(), $conn);
                // Optionally log what was moved for debugging
                error_log('Moved temp uploads for session ' . session_id() . ': ' . json_encode($moved));
            }

            // Use robust flash helper and set legacy session key for compatibility (mirror edit behavior)
            require_once __DIR__ . '/flash.php';
            if (function_exists('add_flash')) { add_flash(t('property_added_success'), 6); }
            // session is written before redirect
            session_write_close(); // Force session data to be saved now
            header("Location: view_property.php?id=" . $new_property_id . "&added=1");
            exit();
        } else {
            error_log("DB Error (add_residential_property): " . $stmt->error);
            $errors[] = t('database_error') . ': ' . $stmt->error;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        error_log("DB Prepare Error (add_residential_property): " . $conn->error);
        $errors[] = t('database_error');
    }
}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Initialize interactive map using Leaflet only
    let map;
    let marker;

    function initMap() {
        const defaultLat = 30.0444;
        const defaultLng = 31.2357;

        const latInput = document.getElementById('latitude');
        const lngInput = document.getElementById('longitude');
        const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value) || defaultLat;
        const lng = parseFloat(lngInput.value) || defaultLng;

        if (typeof L === 'undefined') {
            console.error('Leaflet is not loaded.');
            return;
        }

        map = L.map('map').setView([lat, lng], 10);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            maxZoom: 19,
            attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(map);

        if (!isNaN(parseFloat(latInput.value)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lngInput.value))) {
            marker = L.marker([lat, lng]).addTo(map);
        }

        map.on('click', function(e) {
            const clickedLat = e.latlng.lat;
            const clickedLng = e.latlng.lng;

            latInput.value = clickedLat;
            lngInput.value = clickedLng;

            if (marker) { map.removeLayer(marker); }
            marker = L.marker([clickedLat, clickedLng]).addTo(map);
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener('load', initMap);
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

if (!array_key_exists($sort_column, $allowed_sort_columns)) {

}

// Fetch distinct governorates for the filter dropdown
$governorates_list = [];

if ($stmt_gov = $conn->prepare($sql_governorates)) {
    if ($stmt_gov->execute()) {
        $result_governorates = $stmt_gov->get_result();
        while ($row_gov = $result_governorates->fetch_assoc()) {

// Fetch distinct companies for the filter dropdown
$companies_list = [];

    if ($stmt_comp->execute()) {
        $result_companies = $stmt_comp->get_result();
        while ($row_comp = $result_companies->fetch_assoc()) {
            $companies_list[] = $row_comp['company_name'];

                     FROM Properties p 
                     WHERE p.unit_design IS NOT NULL AND p.unit_design != ''
                     ORDER BY p.unit_design";
if ($stmt_designs = $conn->prepare($sql_unit_designs)) {
    if ($stmt_designs->execute()) {
        $result_designs = $stmt_designs->get_result();
        while ($row_design = $result_designs->fetch_assoc()) {
            $unit_designs[] = $row_design['DesignName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_designs->close();
}

// Fetch property types for the filter dropdown
$property_types = [];
$sql_property_types = "SELECT PropertyTypeID, TypeName FROM PropertyTypes ORDER BY TypeName";
if ($stmt_types = $conn->prepare($sql_property_types)) {
    if ($stmt_types->execute()) {
        $result_types = $stmt_types->get_result();
        while ($row_type = $result_types->fetch_assoc()) {
            $property_types[$row_type['PropertyTypeID']] = $row_type['TypeName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_types->close();
}

// Build the main SQL query with proper joins for unit design and finishing type
$sql_select = "SELECT p.*, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               p.unit_design AS UnitDesignName, pft.FinishingName AS FinishingTypeName
               FROM Properties p
               LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
               LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
               -- Unit design is now a text field, no join needed
               LEFT JOIN PropertyFinishingTypes pft ON p.finishing_type_id = pft.FinishingID";
$sql_where = [];
$params = [];
$types = "";

// Add listing_type filter (mandatory based on session mode)
$sql_where[] = "p.listing_type = ?";
$params[] = $current_mode;
$types .= "s";

// Add search term filter
if (!empty($search_term)) {
    $sql_where[] = "(p.Title LIKE ? OR p.ProjectName LIKE ? OR p.governorate LIKE ? OR p.district LIKE ? OR p.Location LIKE ? OR p.company_name LIKE ? OR pud.DesignName LIKE ?)";
    $search_param = "%" . $search_term . "%";
    array_push($params, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param);
    $types .= "sssssss";
}

// Add property type filter
if (!empty($property_type_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
    $params[] = $property_type_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add governorate filter
if (!empty($governorate_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.governorate = ?";
    $params[] = $governorate_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add company filter
if (!empty($company_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.company_name = ?";
    $params[] = $company_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add unit design filter
if (!empty($unit_design_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.unit_design = ?";
    $params[] = $unit_design_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add status filter
if (!empty($status_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.Status = ?";
    $params[] = $status_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add advanced filters
if (!empty($min_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments, (p.meter_price_cash * p.Area), (p.meter_price_installments * p.Area)) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments, (p.meter_price_cash * p.Area), (p.meter_price_installments * p.Area)) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($min_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.min_area) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.max_area) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($down_payment_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.down_payment_percentage = ?";
    $params[] = $down_payment_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($payment_period_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.payment_years = ?";
    $params[] = $payment_period_filter;
    $types .= "d"; // decimal/double
}

// Add property type filter for coastal properties
$sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
$params[] = CURRENT_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID;
$types .= "i";

// Combine SQL parts
$sql = $sql_select;
if (!empty($sql_where)) {
    $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $sql_where);
}

// Add sorting
$sql .= " ORDER BY " . $allowed_sort_columns[$sort_column] . " " . strtoupper($sort_direction);

// Prepare and execute the query
$properties = [];
if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    if (!empty($params)) {
        $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
    }

    if ($stmt->execute()) {
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $properties[] = $row;
        }
    } else {
        error_log("Error executing property query: " . $stmt->error . " | SQL: " . $sql . " | Params: " . print_r($params, true));
        $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('database_error');
    }
    $stmt->close();
} else {
    error_log("Error preparing property query: " . $conn->error . " | SQL: " . $sql);
    $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('db_error_prepare');
}

// Function to format price for display
function formatDisplayPrice($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['price_cash'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_cash']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['price_installments'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_installments']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_cash']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_cash']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_installments']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_installments']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    }
    return t('price_not_specified');
}

// Function to format area for display
function formatDisplayArea($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['Area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area']) && !empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area'])) {
        return t("starts_from") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["min_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    } elseif (!empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return t("up_to") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["max_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    }
    return t('area_not_specified');
}

// Function to format payment terms
function formatPaymentTerms($row)
{
    $terms = [];
    
    if (!empty($row['down_payment_percentage']) && is_numeric($row['down_payment_percentage'])) {
        $terms[] = number_format($row['down_payment_percentage'], 0) . '% ' . t('down_payment_percentage');
    }
    
    if (!empty($row['payment_years']) && is_numeric($row['payment_years'])) {
        $terms[] = $row['payment_years'] . ' ' . t('years');
    }
    
    return !empty($terms) ? implode(' + ', $terms) : t('undefined');
}

// Function to get status badge HTML
function getStatusBadge($status) {
    $status_classes = [
        'available' => 'status-available',
        'sold' => 'status-sold', 
        'rented' => 'status-rented',
        'unavailable' => 'status-unavailable'
    ];
    
    $status_icons = [
        'available' => 'fas fa-check-circle',
        'sold' => 'fas fa-handshake',
        'rented' => 'fas fa-key',
        'unavailable' => 'fas fa-times-circle'
    ];
    
    $class = $status_classes[$status] ?? 'status-unavailable';
    $icon = $status_icons[$status] ?? 'fas fa-question-circle';
    $text = t('status_' . $status);
    
    return "<span class=\"status-badge {$class}\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$text}</span>";
}

// Function to get property type badge HTML
function getPropertyTypeBadge($typeId, $typeName) {
    $type_icons = [
        1 => 'fas fa-home',      // سكني
        2 => 'fas fa-umbrella-beach', // ساحلي
        3 => 'fas fa-building',  // إداري
        4 => 'fas fa-store',     // تجاري
        5 => 'fas fa-hotel',     // فندقي
        6 => 'fas fa-hospital'   // طبي
    ];
    
    $icon = $type_icons[$typeId] ?? 'fas fa-landmark';
    
    return "<span class=\"property-type-badge\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$typeName}</span>";
}

                                <?php echo formatDisplayArea($property); ?>
                            </td>

                                <div class="location-main">

                                </div>
                                <?php if (!empty($property["district"]) && $property["district"] !== $property["governorate"]): ?>
                                <div class="location-sub">
                                    <?php echo htmlspecialchars($property["district"]); ?>
                                </div>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                            </td>
                            <td class="cell-company">
                                <?php echo htmlspecialchars($property['company_name'] ?? t('undefined')); ?>

                            <td class="cell-actions">

                                        <i class="fas fa-edit"></i>
                                    </a>
                                    <form method="POST" action="delete_property.php" style="display:inline" onsubmit="return confirm('<?php echo t('confirm_delete_property'); ?>');">
                                        <input type="hidden" name="id" value="<?php echo (int)$property['PropertyID']; ?>">
                                        <?php echo csrf_input(); ?>
                                        <button type="submit" class="btn-delete" title="<?php echo t('delete'); ?>">
                                            <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                                        </button>
                                    </form>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <?php endif; ?>
                        </tr>
                        <?php $row_number++; ?>
                    <?php endforeach; ?>
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    <?php endif; ?>
</div>

<script>
    function toggleAdvancedFilters() {
        const advancedFilters = document.getElementById('advancedFilters');
        const toggleButton = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters-toggle');
        
        if (advancedFilters.classList.contains('show')) {
            advancedFilters.classList.remove('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sliders-h"></i> <?php echo t('advanced_filters'); ?>';
        } else {
            advancedFilters.classList.add('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> <?php echo t('hide_advanced_filters'); ?>';
        }
    }
    
    // Show advanced filters if any of them are set
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const hasAdvancedFilters = <?php echo
            !empty($min_price_filter) ||
            !empty($max_price_filter) ||
            !empty($min_area_filter) ||
            !empty($max_area_filter) ||
            !empty($down_payment_filter) ||
            !empty($payment_period_filter) ? 'true' : 'false';
        ?>;
        
        if (hasAdvancedFilters) {
            toggleAdvancedFilters();
        }
    });
</script>

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';
ensure_secure_session_started();
require_once __DIR__ . '/lang/translate.php'; // Include translation handler
require_once 'session_check.php'; // Include session timeout check
require_once __DIR__ . '/db.php'; // Database connection
require_once __DIR__ . '/sorting_helpers.php'; // Include sorting helper functions
require_once 'permissions.php'; // Include permissions system
require_once __DIR__ . '/property_image_helper.php'; // Include image helper functions

// Check permissions - all logged in users can view properties
check_permission('view_properties');

// Enforce mode selection - redirect to dashboard if no mode is set
if (!isset($_SESSION['listing_context']) || ($_SESSION['listing_context'] !== 'Primary' && $_SESSION['listing_context'] !== 'Resale')) {
    header('Location: dashboard.php');
    exit();
}

$current_mode = $_SESSION['listing_context'];

// Define the Property Type IDs for this page (Commercial/Administrative/Medical/Hotel - VERIFY IN DB)
const CURRENT_PROPERTY_TYPE_IDS = [3, 4, 5, 6]; // Adjust based on your database

// Initialize search and filter variables
$search_term = $governorate_filter = $company_filter = $status_filter = $property_type_filter = "";
$min_price_filter = $max_price_filter = $min_area_filter = $max_area_filter = $down_payment_filter = $payment_period_filter = "";
$unit_design_filter = "";
$view_mode = isset($_GET['view']) && $_GET['view'] === 'card' ? 'card' : 'table';

// Initialize sorting variables
$sort_column = isset($_GET['sort']) ? trim($_GET['sort']) : 'DateAdded';
$sort_direction = isset($_GET['direction']) && $_GET['direction'] === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';

// Validate sort column to prevent SQL injection
$allowed_sort_columns = [
    'PropertyID' => 'p.PropertyID',
    'DateAdded' => 'p.DateAdded',
    'Price' => 'COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments, (p.meter_price_cash * p.Area), (p.meter_price_installments * p.Area))',
    'Area' => 'COALESCE(p.Area, p.avg_area)',
    'ProjectName' => 'p.ProjectName',
    'Title' => 'p.Title',
    'governorate' => 'p.governorate',
    'Status' => 'p.Status'
];

if (!array_key_exists($sort_column, $allowed_sort_columns)) {
    $sort_column = 'DateAdded';
}

// Process search and filter inputs
if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "GET") {
    $search_term = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim($_GET['search']) : '';
    $governorate_filter = isset($_GET['governorate']) ? trim($_GET['governorate']) : '';
    $company_filter = isset($_GET['company']) ? trim($_GET['company']) : '';
    $unit_design_filter = isset($_GET['unit_design']) ? trim($_GET['unit_design']) : '';
    $status_filter = isset($_GET['status']) ? trim($_GET['status']) : '';
    $property_type_filter = isset($_GET['property_type']) ? trim($_GET['property_type']) : '';

    // Advanced filters
    $min_price_filter = isset($_GET['min_price']) && is_numeric($_GET['min_price']) ? trim($_GET['min_price']) : '';
    $max_price_filter = isset($_GET['max_price']) && is_numeric($_GET['max_price']) ? trim($_GET['max_price']) : '';
    $min_area_filter = isset($_GET['min_area']) && is_numeric($_GET['min_area']) ? trim($_GET['min_area']) : '';
    $max_area_filter = isset($_GET['max_area']) && is_numeric($_GET['max_area']) ? trim($_GET['max_area']) : '';
    $down_payment_filter = isset($_GET['down_payment']) ? trim($_GET['down_payment']) : '';
    $payment_period_filter = isset($_GET['payment_period']) ? trim($_GET['payment_period']) : '';
}

// Fetch distinct governorates for the filter dropdown
$governorates_list = [];
$sql_governorates = "SELECT DISTINCT governorate FROM Properties WHERE governorate IS NOT NULL AND governorate != '' ORDER BY governorate";
if ($stmt_gov = $conn->prepare($sql_governorates)) {
    if ($stmt_gov->execute()) {
        $result_governorates = $stmt_gov->get_result();
        while ($row_gov = $result_governorates->fetch_assoc()) {
            $governorates_list[] = $row_gov['governorate'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_gov->close();
}

// Fetch distinct companies for the filter dropdown
$companies_list = [];
$sql_companies = "SELECT DISTINCT company_name FROM Properties WHERE company_name IS NOT NULL AND company_name != '' ORDER BY company_name";
if ($stmt_comp = $conn->prepare($sql_companies)) {
    if ($stmt_comp->execute()) {
        $result_companies = $stmt_comp->get_result();
        while ($row_comp = $result_companies->fetch_assoc()) {
            $companies_list[] = $row_comp['company_name'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_comp->close();
}

// Fetch unit designs for the filter dropdown
$unit_designs = [];
$sql_unit_designs = "SELECT DISTINCT p.unit_design AS DesignName 
                     FROM Properties p 
                     WHERE p.unit_design IS NOT NULL AND p.unit_design != ''
                     ORDER BY p.unit_design";
if ($stmt_designs = $conn->prepare($sql_unit_designs)) {
    if ($stmt_designs->execute()) {
        $result_designs = $stmt_designs->get_result();
        while ($row_design = $result_designs->fetch_assoc()) {
            $unit_designs[] = $row_design['DesignName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_designs->close();
}

// Fetch property types for the filter dropdown
$property_types = [];
$sql_property_types = "SELECT PropertyTypeID, TypeName FROM PropertyTypes ORDER BY TypeName";
if ($stmt_types = $conn->prepare($sql_property_types)) {
    if ($stmt_types->execute()) {
        $result_types = $stmt_types->get_result();
        while ($row_type = $result_types->fetch_assoc()) {
            $property_types[$row_type['PropertyTypeID']] = $row_type['TypeName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_types->close();
}

// Build the main SQL query with proper joins for unit design and finishing type
$sql_select = "SELECT p.*, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               p.unit_design AS UnitDesignName, pft.FinishingName AS FinishingTypeName
               FROM Properties p
               LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
               LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
               -- Unit design is now a text field, no join needed
               LEFT JOIN PropertyFinishingTypes pft ON p.finishing_type_id = pft.FinishingID";
$sql_where = [];
$params = [];
$types = "";

// Add listing_type filter (mandatory based on session mode)
$sql_where[] = "p.listing_type = ?";
$params[] = $current_mode;
$types .= "s";

// Add search term filter
if (!empty($search_term)) {
    $sql_where[] = "(p.Title LIKE ? OR p.ProjectName LIKE ? OR p.governorate LIKE ? OR p.district LIKE ? OR p.Location LIKE ? OR p.company_name LIKE ? OR pud.DesignName LIKE ?)";
    $search_param = "%" . $search_term . "%";
    array_push($params, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param);
    $types .= "sssssss";
}

// Add property type filter
if (!empty($property_type_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
    $params[] = $property_type_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add governorate filter
if (!empty($governorate_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.governorate = ?";
    $params[] = $governorate_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add company filter
if (!empty($company_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.company_name = ?";
    $params[] = $company_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add unit design filter
if (!empty($unit_design_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.unit_design = ?";
    $params[] = $unit_design_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add status filter
if (!empty($status_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.Status = ?";
    $params[] = $status_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add advanced filters
if (!empty($min_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments, (p.meter_price_cash * p.Area), (p.meter_price_installments * p.Area)) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments, (p.meter_price_cash * p.Area), (p.meter_price_installments * p.Area)) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($min_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.min_area) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.max_area) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($down_payment_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.down_payment_percentage = ?";
    $params[] = $down_payment_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($payment_period_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.payment_years = ?";
    $params[] = $payment_period_filter;
    $types .= "d"; // decimal/double
}

// Add property type filter for commercial properties (multiple types)
$placeholders = str_repeat('?,', count(CURRENT_PROPERTY_TYPE_IDS) - 1) . '?';
$sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID IN ($placeholders)";
foreach (CURRENT_PROPERTY_TYPE_IDS as $type_id) {
    $params[] = $type_id;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Combine SQL parts
$sql = $sql_select;
if (!empty($sql_where)) {
    $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $sql_where);
}

// Add sorting
$sql .= " ORDER BY " . $allowed_sort_columns[$sort_column] . " " . strtoupper($sort_direction);

// Prepare and execute the query
$properties = [];
if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    if (!empty($params)) {
        $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
    }

    if ($stmt->execute()) {
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $properties[] = $row;
        }
    } else {
        error_log("Error executing property query: " . $stmt->error . " | SQL: " . $sql . " | Params: " . print_r($params, true));
        $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('database_error');
    }
    $stmt->close();
} else {
    error_log("Error preparing property query: " . $conn->error . " | SQL: " . $sql);
    $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('db_error_prepare');
}

// Function to format price for display
function formatDisplayPrice($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['price_cash'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_cash']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['price_installments'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_installments']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_cash']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_cash']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_installments']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_installments']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    }
    return t('price_not_specified');
}

// Function to format area for display
function formatDisplayArea($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['Area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area']) && !empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area'])) {
        return t("starts_from") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["min_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    } elseif (!empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return t("up_to") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["max_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    }
    return t('area_not_specified');
}

// Function to format payment terms
function formatPaymentTerms($row)
{
    $terms = [];
    
    if (!empty($row['down_payment_percentage']) && is_numeric($row['down_payment_percentage'])) {
        $terms[] = number_format($row['down_payment_percentage'], 0) . '% ' . t('down_payment_percentage');
    }
    
    if (!empty($row['payment_years']) && is_numeric($row['payment_years'])) {
        $terms[] = $row['payment_years'] . ' ' . t('years');
    }
    
    return !empty($terms) ? implode(' + ', $terms) : t('undefined');
}

// Function to get status badge HTML
function getStatusBadge($status) {
    $status_classes = [
        'available' => 'status-available',
        'sold' => 'status-sold', 
        'rented' => 'status-rented',
        'unavailable' => 'status-unavailable'
    ];
    
    $status_icons = [
        'available' => 'fas fa-check-circle',
        'sold' => 'fas fa-handshake',
        'rented' => 'fas fa-key',
        'unavailable' => 'fas fa-times-circle'
    ];
    
    $class = $status_classes[$status] ?? 'status-unavailable';
    $icon = $status_icons[$status] ?? 'fas fa-question-circle';
    $text = t('status_' . $status);
    
    return "<span class=\"status-badge {$class}\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$text}</span>";
}

// Function to get property type badge HTML
function getPropertyTypeBadge($typeId, $typeName) {
    $type_icons = [
        1 => 'fas fa-home',      // سكني
        2 => 'fas fa-umbrella-beach', // ساحلي
        3 => 'fas fa-building',  // إداري
        4 => 'fas fa-store',     // تجاري
        5 => 'fas fa-hotel',     // فندقي
        6 => 'fas fa-hospital'   // طبي
    ];
    
    $icon = $type_icons[$typeId] ?? 'fas fa-landmark';
    
    return "<span class=\"property-type-badge\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$typeName}</span>";
}

    function toggleAdvancedFilters() {
        const advancedFilters = document.getElementById('advancedFilters');
        const toggleButton = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters-toggle');
        
        if (advancedFilters.classList.contains('show')) {
            advancedFilters.classList.remove('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sliders-h"></i> <?php echo t('advanced_filters'); ?>';
        } else {
            advancedFilters.classList.add('show');
            toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> <?php echo t('hide_advanced_filters'); ?>';
        }
    }
    
    // Show advanced filters if any of them are set
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const hasAdvancedFilters = <?php echo
            !empty($min_price_filter) ||
            !empty($max_price_filter) ||
            !empty($min_area_filter) ||
            !empty($max_area_filter) ||
            !empty($down_payment_filter) ||
            !empty($payment_period_filter) ? 'true' : 'false';
        ?>;
        
        if (hasAdvancedFilters) {
            toggleAdvancedFilters();
        }
    });
</script>

<?php
// Database connection settings
// IMPORTANT: For a production environment, store credentials securely outside the webroot
// (e.g., using environment variables or a dedicated, restricted configuration file).

// Attempt to get credentials from environment variables (best practice)
$host = getenv('DB_HOST') ?: "127.0.0.1";
$user = getenv('DB_USER') ?: "root";
$pass = getenv('DB_PASS') ?: "";
$dbname = getenv('DB_NAME') ?: "broman_db";

// Use mysqli_report to turn errors into exceptions for better handling
mysqli_report(MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT);

try {
    $conn = new mysqli($host, $user, $pass, $dbname);

    // Set character set to UTF-8
    if (!$conn->set_charset("utf8mb4")) {
        // Log the error, but don't necessarily die immediately unless critical
        error_log("Critical Error: Could not set character set utf8mb4: " . $conn->error);
        // Depending on application needs, you might throw an exception or handle this differently
        // For now, we log it and continue, but this is risky for data integrity.
    }

} catch (mysqli_sql_exception $e) {
    // Log the detailed error for administrators
    error_log("Database connection failed: " . $e->getMessage() . " (Code: " . $e->getCode() . ")");

    // Display a generic, user-friendly error message
    // In a real application, you might redirect to an error page or display a message within the layout.
    die("Sorry, we are experiencing technical difficulties. Please try again later or contact support.");
}

/**
 * Helper: safe_bind_param
 * Validates that the types string length matches the number of variables
 * and then invokes bind_param on the provided statement.
 *
 * Usage: safe_bind_param($stmt, 'issd', $a, $b, $c, $d);
 */
function safe_bind_param(mysqli_stmt $stmt, string $types /*, mixed ...$vars */)
{
    $vars = array_slice(func_get_args(), 2);
    $typesLen = strlen($types);
    $varsCount = count($vars);
    if ($typesLen !== $varsCount) {
        // Log detailed debug info and throw an exception with a helpful message
        $msg = sprintf("bind_param mismatch: types string length=%d but vars count=%d", $typesLen, $varsCount);
        error_log("DB: " . $msg . "; types='$types'; vars=[" . implode(', ', array_map(function($v){ return is_null($v)?'NULL':(is_scalar($v)?(string)$v:gettype($v)); }, $vars)) . "]");
        throw new InvalidArgumentException($msg);
    }

    // mysqli_stmt::bind_param requires parameters to be passed by reference.
    // Build an array of references to the variables.
    $refs = [];
    foreach ($vars as $key => &$val) { $refs[$key] = &$val; }

    // Prepend the types string
    array_unshift($refs, $types);

    // Call bind_param with unpacked references
    return $stmt->bind_param(...$refs);
}

/**
 * Helper: get_enum_values
 * Returns an array of allowed ENUM values for a given table column.
 */
function get_enum_values(mysqli $conn, string $table, string $column): array
{
    $schema = $conn->real_escape_string($conn->query("SELECT DATABASE() as db")->fetch_assoc()['db']);
    $table_esc = $conn->real_escape_string($table);
    $col_esc = $conn->real_escape_string($column);

    $sql = "SELECT COLUMN_TYPE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '" . $schema . "' AND TABLE_NAME = '" . $table_esc . "' AND COLUMN_NAME = '" . $col_esc . "' LIMIT 1";
    try {
        $res = $conn->query($sql);
        if ($res && $row = $res->fetch_assoc()) {
            $type = $row['COLUMN_TYPE']; // e.g. "enum('a','b')"
            if (preg_match("/^enum\((.*)\)$/i", $type, $matches)) {
                $vals = str_getcsv($matches[1], ',', "'");
                // Trim surrounding quotes if any
                return array_map(function($v) { return trim($v, "'"); }, $vals);
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("get_enum_values error: " . $e->getMessage());
    }
    return [];
}

/**
 * Helper: normalize_seller_type_for_db
 * Ensures the posted seller_type matches one of the allowed ENUM values in the DB.
 * If the DB hasn't been migrated to the new taxonomy, this function will attempt
 * to map common new values to their legacy equivalents, otherwise returns null.
 */
function normalize_seller_type_for_db(mysqli $conn, $value)
{
    if ($value === null) return null;
    $val = trim((string)$value);
    if ($val === '') return null;

    $allowed = get_enum_values($conn, 'properties', 'seller_type');
    if (in_array($val, $allowed, true)) {
        return $val;
    }

    // Mapping from new taxonomy to legacy enum values (best-effort)
    $map = [
        // new => legacy
        'مالك' => 'مالك مباشر',
        'وسيط' => 'مكتب عقاري',
        'وكيل' => 'وكيل',
        'بواب' => 'وكيل', // nothing exact in legacy; map to 'وكيل' as fallback
        'شركة مطورة' => 'مطور عقاري',
        'شركة تشطيب' => 'مطور عقاري',
    ];

    if (isset($map[$val]) && in_array($map[$val], $allowed, true)) {
        return $map[$val];
    }

    // Last attempt: try partial matches (e.g., contains)
    foreach ($allowed as $a) {
        if (mb_stripos($a, $val) !== false || mb_stripos($val, $a) !== false) {
            return $a;
        }
    }

    // Not allowed: return null so DB stores NULL instead of an empty/invalid enum value
    return null;
}

<?php
session_start();
require_once 'db.php';
require_once 'permissions.php';

// Check if user is logged in
if (!isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) || $_SESSION["loggedin"] !== true) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Unauthorized']);
    exit;
}

// Check if user has permission to manage properties (admin or manager)
if (!can_manage_properties()) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Permission denied']);
    exit;
}

// CSRF protection
if (!isset($_POST['csrf_token']) || $_POST['csrf_token'] !== $_SESSION['csrf_token']) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'CSRF token mismatch']);
    exit;
}

$media_type = $_POST['media_type'] ?? ''; // 'image', 'audio' or 'video'
$media_id = $_POST['media_id'] ?? '';

// Validate input
if (!in_array($media_type, ['image', 'audio', 'video']) || empty($media_id)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid media type or ID']);
    exit;
}

$media_id = intval($media_id);

if ($media_type === 'image') {
    deleteImage($media_id, $conn);
} elseif ($media_type === 'audio') {
    deleteAudio($media_id, $conn);
} elseif ($media_type === 'video') {
    deleteVideo($media_id, $conn);
}

/**
 * Delete a video record and its file
 */
function deleteVideo($video_id, $conn) {
    $sql = "SELECT VideoPath FROM property_videos WHERE VideoID = ?";
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $video_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();

        if ($result->num_rows === 1) {
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
            $file_path = $row['VideoPath'];
            $full_path = __DIR__ . '/' . $file_path;

            $delete_sql = "DELETE FROM property_videos WHERE VideoID = ?";
            if ($delete_stmt = $conn->prepare($delete_sql)) {
                $delete_stmt->bind_param("i", $video_id);
                if ($delete_stmt->execute()) {
                    if (file_exists($full_path)) {
                        @unlink($full_path);
                    }
                    echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Video deleted successfully']);
                } else {
                    http_response_code(500);
                    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database error: ' . $delete_stmt->error]);
                }
                $delete_stmt->close();
            } else {
                http_response_code(500);
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
            }
        } else {
            http_response_code(404);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Video not found']);
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
    }
}

function deleteImage($image_id, $conn) {
    // First, get the file path
    $sql = "SELECT file_path, is_primary FROM property_images WHERE image_id = ?";
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $image_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        if ($result->num_rows === 1) {
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
            $file_path = $row['file_path'];
            $is_primary = $row['is_primary'];
            $full_path = __DIR__ . '/' . $file_path;
            
            // Delete from database first
            $delete_sql = "DELETE FROM property_images WHERE image_id = ?";
            if ($delete_stmt = $conn->prepare($delete_sql)) {
                $delete_stmt->bind_param("i", $image_id);
                if ($delete_stmt->execute()) {
                    // Delete file from filesystem
                    if (file_exists($full_path)) {
                        unlink($full_path);
                    }
                    
                    // If this was the primary image, set another image as primary
                    if ($is_primary) {
                        $property_sql = "SELECT property_id FROM property_images WHERE image_id = ?";
                        // We need to get property_id before deletion, so let's modify the approach
                        
                        // Get property_id from the original query
                        $stmt->execute(); // Re-execute to get property_id
                        $result = $stmt->get_result();
                        if ($result->num_rows === 1) {
                            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
                            // Actually, we already deleted the record, so we need a different approach
                        }
                        
                        // Alternative: Get property_id from another image of the same property
                        $update_primary_sql = "UPDATE property_images SET is_primary = 1 WHERE property_id = (SELECT property_id FROM (SELECT property_id FROM property_images WHERE image_id != ? LIMIT 1) as temp) LIMIT 1";
                        // This is complex, let's simplify by getting property_id first
                    }
                    
                    echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Image deleted successfully']);
                } else {
                    http_response_code(500);
                    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database error: ' . $delete_stmt->error]);
                }
                $delete_stmt->close();
            } else {
                http_response_code(500);
                echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
            }
        } else {
            http_response_code(404);
            echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Image not found']);
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database prepare error: ' . $conn->error]);
    }
}

FILE: edit_employee.php
============================================================
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';
ensure_secure_session_started();
require_once 'session_check.php'; // Include session timeout check
require_once 'permissions.php'; // Include permissions system

// Check permissions - only manager can manage employees
check_permission('manage_employees');

require_once 'db.php'; // Database connection
require_once 'navbar.php'; // Navigation bar

// Initialize variables
$employee_id = $full_name = $username = $role = "";
$full_name_err = $username_err = $password_err = $role_err = $general_err = "";
$is_editing_self = false;

// Check if ID is provided in URL
if (isset($_GET["id"]) && !empty(trim($_GET["id"]))) {
    $employee_id = trim($_GET["id"]);
    if ($_SESSION["employee_id"] == $employee_id) {
        $is_editing_self = true;
    }

    // Prepare a select statement to fetch employee details
    $sql_fetch = "SELECT FullName, Username, Role FROM Employees WHERE EmployeeID = ?";
    if ($stmt_fetch = $conn->prepare($sql_fetch)) {
        $stmt_fetch->bind_param("i", $param_employee_id);
        $param_employee_id = $employee_id;

        if ($stmt_fetch->execute()) {
            $stmt_fetch->store_result();
            if ($stmt_fetch->num_rows == 1) {
                $stmt_fetch->bind_result($full_name, $username, $role);
                $stmt_fetch->fetch();
            } else {
                $_SESSION["error_message"] = "Employee not found.";
                header("Location: employees_list.php");
                exit();
            }
        } else {
            $general_err = "Error fetching employee details.";
            error_log("Error executing employee fetch: " . $stmt_fetch->error);
        }
        $stmt_fetch->close();
    } else {
        $general_err = "Database error (employee fetch). Please try again.";
        error_log("Error preparing employee fetch: " . $conn->error);
    }
} else {
    $_SESSION["error_message"] = "No employee ID specified for editing.";
    header("Location: employees_list.php");
    exit();
}

// Processing form data when form is submitted
if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    if (!validateCSRFToken($_POST['csrf_token'] ?? null)) {
        $general_err = t('invalid_csrf_token');
    }
    $employee_id_post = trim($_POST["employee_id"]);
    if (empty($employee_id_post) || $employee_id_post != $employee_id) {
        $general_err = "Invalid employee ID submitted.";
    }

    // Validate Full Name
    if (empty(trim($_POST["fullName"]))) {
        $full_name_err = "Please enter the employee's full name.";
    } else {
        $full_name_posted = trim($_POST["fullName"]);
    }

    // Validate Username
    if (empty(trim($_POST["username"]))) {
        $username_err = "Please enter a username.";
    } elseif (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', trim($_POST["username"]))) {
        $username_err = "Username can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.";
    } else {
        $sql_check_username = "SELECT EmployeeID FROM Employees WHERE Username = ? AND EmployeeID != ?";
        if ($stmt_check = $conn->prepare($sql_check_username)) {
            $stmt_check->bind_param("si", $param_username_check, $param_employee_id_check);
            $param_username_check = trim($_POST["username"]);
            $param_employee_id_check = $employee_id;
            if ($stmt_check->execute()) {
                $stmt_check->store_result();
                if ($stmt_check->num_rows > 0) {
                    $username_err = "This username is already taken.";
                }
                $username_posted = trim($_POST["username"]);
            } else {
                $general_err = "Error checking username. Please try again.";
                error_log("Error executing username check (edit): " . $stmt_check->error);
            }
            $stmt_check->close();
        } else {
            $general_err = "Database error (username check). Please try again.";
            error_log("Error preparing username check (edit): " . $conn->error);
        }
    }

    // Validate Role
    // Prevent admin from demoting themselves if they are the only admin (basic check)
    if ($is_editing_self && $role === 'admin' && $_POST["role"] === 'user') {
        $sql_count_admins = "SELECT COUNT(EmployeeID) as admin_count FROM Employees WHERE Role = 'admin'";
        $admin_count_result = $conn->query($sql_count_admins);
        $admin_count_row = $admin_count_result->fetch_assoc();
        if ($admin_count_row['admin_count'] <= 1) {
            $role_err = "Cannot demote the only administrator.";
        }
    }
    if (empty($role_err)) { // proceed if no error from self-demotion check
        if (empty($_POST["role"])) {
            $role_err = "Please select a role.";
        } elseif (!in_array($_POST["role"], ["admin", "user", "manager"])) {
            $role_err = "Invalid role selected.";
        } else {
            $role_posted = $_POST["role"];
        }
    }

    // Validate Password (only if new password is provided)
    $new_password = $_POST["new_password"];
    $confirm_password = $_POST["confirm_password"];
    $hashed_password_to_update = null; // Will hold the new hash if password is changed

    if (!empty($new_password)) {
        if (strlen($new_password) < 6) {
            $password_err = "New password must have at least 6 characters.";
        } elseif ($new_password != $confirm_password) {
            $password_err = "New passwords do not match.";
        } else {
            $hashed_password_to_update = password_hash($new_password, PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
        }
    }

    // Check input errors before updating in database
    if (empty($full_name_err) && empty($username_err) && empty($password_err) && empty($role_err) && empty($general_err)) {
        if ($hashed_password_to_update !== null) {
            $sql_update = "UPDATE Employees SET FullName = ?, Username = ?, Role = ?, Password = ? WHERE EmployeeID = ?";
        } else {
            $sql_update = "UPDATE Employees SET FullName = ?, Username = ?, Role = ? WHERE EmployeeID = ?";
        }

        if ($stmt_update = $conn->prepare($sql_update)) {
            if ($hashed_password_to_update !== null) {
                $stmt_update->bind_param("ssssi", $param_full_name, $param_username, $param_role, $param_password, $param_employee_id_update);
                $param_password = $hashed_password_to_update;
            } else {
                $stmt_update->bind_param("sssi", $param_full_name, $param_username, $param_role, $param_employee_id_update);
            }
            
            $param_full_name = $full_name_posted;
            $param_username = $username_posted;
            $param_role = $role_posted;
            $param_employee_id_update = $employee_id;
            
            if ($stmt_update->execute()) {
                require_once __DIR__ . '/flash.php';
                if (function_exists('add_flash')) { add_flash("Employee details updated successfully!", 6); }
                // If admin edited their own role and demoted themselves, log them out or redirect to login
                if ($is_editing_self && $role === 'admin' && $role_posted === 'user') {
                    // Destroy session and redirect to login
                    session_destroy();
                    header("Location: login.php?message=role_changed");
                    exit();
                }
                header("Location: employees_list.php");
                exit();
            } else {
                $general_err = "Something went wrong. Please try again later.";
                error_log("Error executing employee update: " . $stmt_update->error);
            }
            $stmt_update->close();
        }
    } else {
        $full_name = isset($full_name_posted) ? $full_name_posted : $full_name;
        $username = isset($username_posted) ? $username_posted : $username;
        $role = isset($role_posted) ? $role_posted : $role;
    }
}

    <script>
    (function(){
        function postForm(url, fields) {
            const fd = new FormData();
            for (const k in fields) {
                if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fields, k)) continue;
                fd.append(k, fields[k]);
            }
            return fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(r => r.json());
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
            const target = e.target;
            if (target.classList.contains('delete-media-btn')) {
                const id = target.dataset.id;
                const type = target.dataset.type || 'image';
                if (!confirm('<?php echo t('confirm_delete_media'); ?>')) return;
                // CSRF token from container
                const container = document.querySelector('.container');
                const csrf = container ? container.getAttribute('data-csrf-token') : '';
                postForm('delete_media.php', { media_type: type, media_id: id, csrf_token: csrf })
                    .then(res => {
                        if (res.success) {
                            const el = target.closest('.existing-media-item');
                            if (el) el.remove();
                        } else {
                            alert(res.message || '<?php echo t('delete_failed'); ?>');
                        }
                    }).catch(err => alert(err.message || '<?php echo t('delete_failed'); ?>'));
            } else if (target.classList.contains('set-primary-btn')) {
                const id = target.dataset.id;
                if (!confirm('<?php echo t('confirm_set_primary'); ?>')) return;
                const container = document.querySelector('.container');
                const csrf = container ? container.getAttribute('data-csrf-token') : '';
                postForm('set_primary_image.php', { image_id: id, csrf_token: csrf, property_id: <?php echo intval($property_id); ?> })
                    .then(res => {
                        if (res.success) {
                            // update badges in-place: remove existing main badge and add to this one
                            document.querySelectorAll('.existing-media-item .badge-primary').forEach(b => b.remove());
                            // replace any set-primary buttons into badges for others
                            document.querySelectorAll('.existing-media-item .set-primary-btn').forEach(btn => {
                                btn.style.display = '';
                            });
                            // hide the clicked button and add badge
                            const parentItem = target.closest('.existing-media-item');
                            if (parentItem) {
                                // hide this button
                                target.style.display = 'none';
                                const span = document.createElement('span');
                                span.className = 'badge badge-primary';
                                span.textContent = '<?php echo t('main_image'); ?>';
                                parentItem.querySelector('.existing-media-actions .left-actions')?.prepend(span);
                            }
                        } else {
                            alert(res.message || '<?php echo t('operation_failed'); ?>');
                        }
                    }).catch(err => alert(err.message || '<?php echo t('operation_failed'); ?>'));
            }
        });
    })();
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const propertyTypeIdSelect = document.getElementById('property_type_id');
            const residentialCoastalFields = document.getElementById('residential_coastal_fields');
            const commercialFields = document.getElementById('commercial_fields');

            const RESIDENTIAL_ID = <?php echo RESIDENTIAL_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;
            const COASTAL_ID = <?php echo COASTAL_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;
            const COMMERCIAL_ID = <?php echo COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;
            const ADMINISTRATIVE_ID = <?php echo ADMINISTRATIVE_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;
            const HOTEL_ID = <?php echo HOTEL_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;
            const MEDICAL_ID = <?php echo MEDICAL_PROPERTY_TYPE_ID; ?>;

            function togglePropertyTypeFields() {
                const selectedTypeId = parseInt(propertyTypeIdSelect.value);

                if (selectedTypeId === RESIDENTIAL_ID || selectedTypeId === COASTAL_ID) {
                    residentialCoastalFields.classList.add('active');
                    commercialFields.classList.remove('active');

                    // Enable/disable required attributes for residential/coastal
                    const unitDesignField = document.getElementById('unit_design');
                    const finishingTypeField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id');
                    const finishingTypeCommercialField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id_commercial');
                    
                    if (unitDesignField) unitDesignField.setAttribute('required', 'required');
                    if (finishingTypeField) {
                        finishingTypeField.setAttribute('required', 'required');
                        finishingTypeField.disabled = false;
                    }
                    if (finishingTypeCommercialField) {
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.removeAttribute('required');
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.disabled = true;
                    }

                } else if (selectedTypeId === COMMERCIAL_ID || selectedTypeId === ADMINISTRATIVE_ID || selectedTypeId === HOTEL_ID || selectedTypeId === MEDICAL_ID) {
                    residentialCoastalFields.classList.remove('active');
                    commercialFields.classList.add('active');

                    // Enable/disable required attributes for commercial
                    const unitDesignField = document.getElementById('unit_design');
                    const finishingTypeField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id');
                    const finishingTypeCommercialField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id_commercial');
                    
                    if (unitDesignField) unitDesignField.removeAttribute('required');
                    if (finishingTypeField) {
                        finishingTypeField.removeAttribute('required');
                        finishingTypeField.disabled = true;
                    }
                    if (finishingTypeCommercialField) {
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.setAttribute('required', 'required');
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.disabled = false;
                    }

                } else {
                    residentialCoastalFields.classList.remove('active');
                    commercialFields.classList.remove('active');

                    // Remove required attributes if no specific type is selected
                    const unitDesignField = document.getElementById('unit_design');
                    const finishingTypeField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id');
                    const finishingTypeCommercialField = document.getElementById('finishing_type_id_commercial');
                    
                    if (unitDesignField) unitDesignField.removeAttribute('required');
                    if (finishingTypeField) {
                        finishingTypeField.removeAttribute('required');
                        finishingTypeField.disabled = true;
                    }
                    if (finishingTypeCommercialField) {
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.removeAttribute('required');
                        finishingTypeCommercialField.disabled = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Initial call to set correct fields based on loaded property type
            togglePropertyTypeFields();

            // Add event listener for changes
            propertyTypeIdSelect.addEventListener('change', togglePropertyTypeFields);
            
            // Initialize map: Google Maps when available, otherwise Leaflet
            // Leaflet-only map initialization
            let map;
            let marker;

            function initMap() {
                const defaultLat = 30.0444;
                const defaultLng = 31.2357;

                const latInput = document.getElementById('latitude');
                const lngInput = document.getElementById('longitude');
                const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value) || defaultLat;
                const lng = parseFloat(lngInput.value) || defaultLng;

                if (typeof L === 'undefined') {
                    console.error('Leaflet is not loaded.');
                    return;
                }

                map = L.map('map').setView([lat, lng], 10);
                L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
                    maxZoom: 19,
                    attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors'
                }).addTo(map);

                if (!isNaN(parseFloat(latInput.value)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lngInput.value))) {
                    marker = L.marker([lat, lng]).addTo(map);
                }

                map.on('click', function(e) {
                    const clickedLat = e.latlng.lat;
                    const clickedLng = e.latlng.lng;
                    latInput.value = clickedLat;
                    lngInput.value = clickedLng;

                    if (marker) { map.removeLayer(marker); }
                    marker = L.marker([clickedLat, clickedLng]).addTo(map);
                });
            }

            window.addEventListener('load', function() { initMap(); });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';
ensure_secure_session_started();
require_once __DIR__ .
'/lang/translate.php'; // Include translation handler
require_once 'permissions.php'; // Include permissions system

// Check permissions - only manager can manage employees
check_permission('manage_employees');

require_once __DIR__ . '/db.php'; // Include database connection using absolute path

$search_term = isset($_GET['search']) ? trim($_GET['search']) : '';

// Prepare SQL to fetch employees using ACTUAL schema column names from broman_db.sql
$sql = "SELECT EmployeeID, FullName, Username, Role, DateJoined FROM employees"; // Corrected column names
if (!empty($search_term)) {
    // Update search fields based on actual schema
    $sql .= " WHERE FullName LIKE ? OR Username LIKE ? OR Role LIKE ?"; // Search by FullName, Username, Role
}
$sql .= " ORDER BY EmployeeID ASC";

$employees = [];
if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    if (!empty($search_term)) {
        $like_search_term = "%" . $search_term . "%";
        // Bind parameters for new search fields
        $stmt->bind_param("sss", $like_search_term, $like_search_term, $like_search_term);
    }
    if ($stmt->execute()) {
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $employees[] = $row;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    } else {
        error_log("Error fetching employees: " . $stmt->error);
        // Use translation key for error message
        $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('error_retrieving_employees');
    }
} else {
    error_log("Error preparing statement for employees: " . $conn->error);
    // Use translation key for error message
    $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('database_error');
}

$conn->close(); // Close connection after fetching data

// Enhanced sorting functionality for property tables
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Add sorting functionality to all sortable headers
    const sortableHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.sortable');
    
    sortableHeaders.forEach(header => {
        // Add accessibility attributes
        header.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        header.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        
        // Add keyboard support
        header.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                header.click();
            }
        });
        
        // Add visual feedback on click
        header.addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Add loading state
            header.classList.add('sorting-loading');
            
            // Remove loading state after navigation (fallback)
            setTimeout(() => {
                header.classList.remove('sorting-loading');
            }, 1000);
        });
        
        // Add sort hints
        const sortIcon = header.querySelector('.sort-icon');
        if (sortIcon) {
            if (sortIcon.classList.contains('fa-sort')) {
                header.setAttribute('data-sort-hint', 'Click to sort ascending');
            } else if (sortIcon.classList.contains('fa-sort-up')) {
                header.setAttribute('data-sort-hint', 'Click to sort descending');
            } else if (sortIcon.classList.contains('fa-sort-down')) {
                header.setAttribute('data-sort-hint', 'Click to sort ascending');
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Add visual indicators for current sort
    const currentSortColumn = getUrlParameter('sort');
    const currentSortDirection = getUrlParameter('direction');
    
    if (currentSortColumn) {
        sortableHeaders.forEach(header => {
            const onclick = header.getAttribute('onclick');
            if (onclick && onclick.includes(`sort=${currentSortColumn}`)) {
                if (currentSortDirection === 'asc') {
                    header.classList.add('sort-asc');
                } else {
                    header.classList.add('sort-desc');
                }
                header.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Enhanced table responsiveness for sorting
    const table = document.querySelector('.properties-table');
    if (table) {
        // Add horizontal scroll indicator for mobile
        const tableContainer = table.closest('.table-responsive');
        if (tableContainer) {
            const scrollIndicator = document.createElement('div');
            scrollIndicator.className = 'scroll-indicator';
            scrollIndicator.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-arrows-alt-h"></i> Scroll horizontally to see more columns';
            
            // Show indicator on mobile if table is wider than container
            function checkScrollIndicator() {
                if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && table.scrollWidth > tableContainer.clientWidth) {
                    if (!tableContainer.querySelector('.scroll-indicator')) {
                        tableContainer.appendChild(scrollIndicator);
                    }
                } else {
                    const indicator = tableContainer.querySelector('.scroll-indicator');
                    if (indicator) {
                        indicator.remove();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            checkScrollIndicator();
            window.addEventListener('resize', checkScrollIndicator);
        }
    }
});

// Helper function to get URL parameters
function getUrlParameter(name) {
    name = name.replace(/[\[]/, '\\[').replace(/[\]]/, '\\]');
    const regex = new RegExp('[\\?&]' + name + '=([^&#]*)');
    const results = regex.exec(location.search);
    return results === null ? '' : decodeURIComponent(results[1].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
}

// Enhanced sorting with smooth transitions
function applySortingTransition() {
    const tableBody = document.querySelector('.properties-table tbody');
    if (tableBody) {
        tableBody.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        tableBody.style.opacity = '0.7';
        
        // Restore opacity after a short delay
        setTimeout(() => {
            tableBody.style.opacity = '1';
        }, 300);
    }
}

// Add CSS for scroll indicator
const scrollIndicatorCSS = `

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #17a2b8, #138496);
