// Enhanced JavaScript for Property Table Filtering and Sorting

class PropertyTableManager {
    constructor() {
        this.currentSort = { column: null, direction: 'asc' };
        this.filters = {};
        this.selectedRows = new Set();
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.initSorting();
        this.initFiltering();
        this.initBulkSelection();
        this.initAdvancedFilters();
        this.initQuickFilters();
    }

    // ================================================
    // Sorting Functionality
    // ================================================
    
    initSorting() {
        const sortableHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.sortable-header');
        sortableHeaders.forEach(header => {
            header.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const column = header.dataset.column;
                this.sortTable(column);
            });
        });
    }

    sortTable(column) {
        const table = document.querySelector('.properties-table tbody');
        const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tr'));
        
        // Determine sort direction
        if (this.currentSort.column === column) {
            this.currentSort.direction = this.currentSort.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        } else {
            this.currentSort.direction = 'asc';
        }
        this.currentSort.column = column;

        // Update header indicators
        this.updateSortIndicators();

        // Sort rows
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
            const aValue = this.getCellValue(a, column);
            const bValue = this.getCellValue(b, column);
            
            let comparison = 0;
            if (this.isNumeric(aValue) && this.isNumeric(bValue)) {
                comparison = parseFloat(aValue) - parseFloat(bValue);
            } else {
                comparison = aValue.localeCompare(bValue, undefined, { numeric: true });
            }
            
            return this.currentSort.direction === 'asc' ? comparison : -comparison;
        });

        // Re-append sorted rows
        rows.forEach(row => table.appendChild(row));
        
        // Add visual feedback
        this.addSortAnimation();
    }

    getCellValue(row, column) {
        const cell = row.querySelector(`.cell-${column}`);
        if (!cell) return '';
        
        // Handle special cases
        if (column === 'price' || column === 'area') {
            const text = cell.textContent.trim();
            const numbers = text.match(/[\d,]+/g);
            return numbers ? numbers[0].replace(/,/g, '') : '0';
        }
        
        return cell.textContent.trim();
    }

    isNumeric(value) {
        return !isNaN(parseFloat(value)) && isFinite(value);
    }

    updateSortIndicators() {
        // Reset all indicators
        document.querySelectorAll('.sort-indicator').forEach(indicator => {
            indicator.className = 'sort-indicator none';
        });
        
        // Update current column indicator
        const currentHeader = document.querySelector(`[data-column="${this.currentSort.column}"]`);
        if (currentHeader) {
            const indicator = currentHeader.querySelector('.sort-indicator');
            if (indicator) {
                indicator.className = `sort-indicator ${this.currentSort.direction}`;
            }
            currentHeader.classList.add('sorted');
        }
        
        // Remove sorted class from other headers
        document.querySelectorAll('.sortable-header').forEach(header => {
            if (header.dataset.column !== this.currentSort.column) {
                header.classList.remove('sorted');
            }
        });
    }

    addSortAnimation() {
        const table = document.querySelector('.properties-table');
        table.style.opacity = '0.7';
        setTimeout(() => {
            table.style.opacity = '1';
        }, 150);
    }

    // ================================================
    // Advanced Filtering
    // ================================================
    
    initFiltering() {
        const filterForm = document.querySelector('.filter-section form');
        if (filterForm) {
            // Add real-time filtering for text inputs
            const textInputs = filterForm.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"], input[type="number"]');
            textInputs.forEach(input => {
                let timeout;
                input.addEventListener('input', () => {
                    clearTimeout(timeout);
                    timeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        this.applyFilters();
                    }, 500);
                });
            });

            // Add change listeners for select elements
            const selects = filterForm.querySelectorAll('select');
            selects.forEach(select => {
                select.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    this.applyFilters();
                });
            });
        }
    }

    applyFilters() {
        const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.properties-table tbody tr');
        let visibleCount = 0;

        rows.forEach(row => {
            const isVisible = this.rowMatchesFilters(row);
            row.style.display = isVisible ? '' : 'none';
            if (isVisible) visibleCount++;
        });

        this.updateResultsCount(visibleCount);
        this.updateNoResultsMessage(visibleCount === 0);
    }

    rowMatchesFilters(row) {
        const filters = this.getActiveFilters();
        
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
            if (!value) continue;
            
            const cell = row.querySelector(`.cell-${key}`);
            if (!cell) continue;
            
            const cellText = cell.textContent.toLowerCase().trim();
            const filterValue = value.toLowerCase().trim();
            
            if (key === 'search') {
                // Search across all cells
                const allText = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td'))
                    .map(td => td.textContent.toLowerCase())
                    .join(' ');
                if (!allText.includes(filterValue)) return false;
            } else if (key.includes('min_') || key.includes('max_')) {
                // Handle numeric range filters
                if (!this.checkNumericFilter(cellText, key, filterValue)) return false;
            } else {
                // Exact or partial match
                if (!cellText.includes(filterValue)) return false;
            }
        }
        
        return true;
    }

    getActiveFilters() {
        const filters = {};
        const form = document.querySelector('.filter-section form');
        if (!form) return filters;

        const inputs = form.querySelectorAll('input, select');
        inputs.forEach(input => {
            if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
                filters[input.name] = input.value.trim();
            }
        });

        return filters;
    }

    checkNumericFilter(cellText, filterKey, filterValue) {
        const cellNumber = parseFloat(cellText.replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''));
        const filterNumber = parseFloat(filterValue);
        
        if (isNaN(cellNumber) || isNaN(filterNumber)) return true;
        
        if (filterKey.startsWith('min_')) {
            return cellNumber >= filterNumber;
        } else if (filterKey.startsWith('max_')) {
            return cellNumber <= filterNumber;
        }
        
        return true;
    }

    updateResultsCount(count) {
        const countElement = document.querySelector('.results-count .count-number');
        if (countElement) {
            countElement.textContent = count;
        }
    }

    updateNoResultsMessage(show) {
        let noResultsDiv = document.querySelector('.no-results-message');
        
        if (show && !noResultsDiv) {
            noResultsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            noResultsDiv.className = 'no-results-message no-properties';
            noResultsDiv.innerHTML = `
                <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
                <h3>No properties match your filters</h3>
                <p>Try adjusting your search criteria or clearing some filters.</p>
            `;
            document.querySelector('.table-responsive').after(noResultsDiv);
        } else if (!show && noResultsDiv) {
            noResultsDiv.remove();
        }
        
        const table = document.querySelector('.table-responsive');
        if (table) {
            table.style.display = show ? 'none' : 'block';
        }
    }

    // ================================================
    // Bulk Selection
    // ================================================
    
    initBulkSelection() {
        const selectAllCheckbox = document.querySelector('.select-all-checkbox');
        if (selectAllCheckbox) {
            selectAllCheckbox.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                this.selectAll(e.target.checked);
            });
        }

        const bulkCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.bulk-checkbox');
        bulkCheckboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
            checkbox.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                this.toggleRowSelection(e.target.value, e.target.checked);
            });
        });
    }

    selectAll(checked) {
        const visibleCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.bulk-checkbox:not([style*="display: none"])');
        visibleCheckboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
            checkbox.checked = checked;
            this.toggleRowSelection(checkbox.value, checked);
        });
    }

    toggleRowSelection(rowId, selected) {
        if (selected) {
            this.selectedRows.add(rowId);
        } else {
            this.selectedRows.delete(rowId);
        }
        
        this.updateBulkActionsBar();
        this.updateSelectAllState();
    }

    updateBulkActionsBar() {
        const bulkBar = document.querySelector('.bulk-actions-bar');
        const selectionInfo = document.querySelector('.bulk-selection-info');
        
        if (this.selectedRows.size > 0) {
            bulkBar?.classList.add('show');
            if (selectionInfo) {
                selectionInfo.textContent = `${this.selectedRows.size} properties selected`;
            }
        } else {
            bulkBar?.classList.remove('show');
        }
    }

    updateSelectAllState() {
        const selectAllCheckbox = document.querySelector('.select-all-checkbox');
        const visibleCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.bulk-checkbox:not([style*="display: none"])');
        const checkedVisible = Array.from(visibleCheckboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked);
        
        if (selectAllCheckbox) {
            selectAllCheckbox.checked = checkedVisible.length === visibleCheckboxes.length && visibleCheckboxes.length > 0;
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = checkedVisible.length > 0 && checkedVisible.length < visibleCheckboxes.length;
        }
    }

    // ================================================
    // Advanced Filters Panel
    // ================================================
    
    initAdvancedFilters() {
        const toggleButton = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters-toggle');
        if (toggleButton) {
            toggleButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                this.toggleAdvancedFilters();
            });
        }
    }

    toggleAdvancedFilters() {
        const panel = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters');
        const toggleButton = document.querySelector('.advanced-filters-toggle');
        
        if (panel && toggleButton) {
            const isVisible = panel.classList.contains('show');
            
            if (isVisible) {
                panel.classList.remove('show');
                toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sliders-h"></i> Advanced Filters';
            } else {
                panel.classList.add('show');
                toggleButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times"></i> Hide Advanced Filters';
            }
        }
    }

    // ================================================
    // Quick Filters
    // ================================================
    
    initQuickFilters() {
        const quickFilters = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip');
        quickFilters.forEach(chip => {
            chip.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.applyQuickFilter(chip);
            });
        });
    }

    applyQuickFilter(chip) {
        // Remove active class from all chips
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        
        // Add active class to clicked chip
        chip.classList.add('active');
        
        // Apply the filter based on chip data
        const filterType = chip.dataset.filter;
        const filterValue = chip.dataset.value;
        
        if (filterType && filterValue) {
            const input = document.querySelector(`[name="${filterType}"]`);
            if (input) {
                input.value = filterValue;
                this.applyFilters();
            }
        }
    }

    // ================================================
    // Export Functionality
    // ================================================
    
    exportSelected(format) {
        if (this.selectedRows.size === 0) {
            alert('Please select properties to export');
            return;
        }
        
        const selectedData = this.getSelectedRowsData();
        
        switch (format) {
            case 'csv':
                this.exportToCSV(selectedData);
                break;
            case 'excel':
                this.exportToExcel(selectedData);
                break;
            case 'pdf':
                this.exportToPDF(selectedData);
                break;
        }
    }

    getSelectedRowsData() {
        const data = [];
        const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.properties-table thead th'))
            .map(th => th.textContent.trim());
        
        this.selectedRows.forEach(rowId => {
            const row = document.querySelector(`tr[data-id="${rowId}"]`);
            if (row) {
                const rowData = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td'))
                    .map(td => td.textContent.trim());
                data.push(rowData);
            }
        });
        
        return { headers, data };
    }

    exportToCSV(data) {
        const csv = [data.headers, ...data.data]
            .map(row => row.map(cell => `"${cell}"`).join(','))
            .join('\\n');
        
        const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = 'properties.csv';
        a.click();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }

    // ================================================
    // Utility Methods
    // ================================================
    
    clearAllFilters() {
        const form = document.querySelector('.filter-section form');
        if (form) {
            form.reset();
            this.applyFilters();
        }
        
        // Clear quick filter selections
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(chip => {
            chip.classList.remove('active');
        });
    }

    resetTable() {
        this.clearAllFilters();
        this.selectedRows.clear();
        this.updateBulkActionsBar();
        this.currentSort = { column: null, direction: 'asc' };
        this.updateSortIndicators();
    }
}

// Initialize the table manager when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    window.propertyTableManager = new PropertyTableManager();
});

// Additional utility functions for advanced features
function toggleAdvancedFilters() {
    if (window.propertyTableManager) {
        window.propertyTableManager.toggleAdvancedFilters();
    }
}

function exportProperties(format) {
    if (window.propertyTableManager) {
        window.propertyTableManager.exportSelected(format);
    }
}

function clearFilters() {
    if (window.propertyTableManager) {
        window.propertyTableManager.clearAllFilters();
    }
}

<?php
// Small flash message helper with short TTL to tolerate duplicate quick reads
// Requires session to be started already (or call ensure_secure_session_started() before use)

if (!function_exists('add_flash')) {
    function add_flash(string $message, int $ttl_seconds = 5): string
    {
        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            // best-effort start
            @session_start();
        }
        if (!isset($_SESSION['flash_messages']) || !is_array($_SESSION['flash_messages'])) {
            $_SESSION['flash_messages'] = [];
        }
        // id for reference if needed
        $id = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        $_SESSION['flash_messages'][$id] = [
            'message' => $message,
            'expires_at' => time() + $ttl_seconds,
        ];
        return $id;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('get_flash_messages')) {
    function get_flash_messages(): array
    {
        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            @session_start();
        }
        $now = time();
        $out = [];
        if (!empty($_SESSION['flash_messages']) && is_array($_SESSION['flash_messages'])) {
            foreach ($_SESSION['flash_messages'] as $id => $item) {
                if (!is_array($item)) { unset($_SESSION['flash_messages'][$id]); continue; }
                if (isset($item['expires_at']) && $item['expires_at'] >= $now) {
                    $out[$id] = $item['message'];
                } else {
                    // expired — remove
                    unset($_SESSION['flash_messages'][$id]);
                }
            }
            // If none remain, remove the container
            if (empty($_SESSION['flash_messages'])) { unset($_SESSION['flash_messages']); }
        }
        return $out;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('clear_flash')) {
    function clear_flash(string $id): void
    {
        if (session_status() !== PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            @session_start();
        }
        if (!empty($_SESSION['flash_messages'][$id])) {
            unset($_SESSION['flash_messages'][$id]);
        }
        if (empty($_SESSION['flash_messages'])) { unset($_SESSION['flash_messages']); }
    }
}

?>

// Helper function to parse numeric values from Excel for DB storage
function parseNumericValueForDB($value_from_excel, $is_price_field = false)
{
    if ($value_from_excel === null || $value_from_excel === '') {
        return null;
    }
    // Remove dots (thousand separators) and any other non-numeric characters except a single decimal point for actual decimals
    $cleaned_value = str_replace('.', '', (string)$value_from_excel);
    // If the original had a comma for decimal, switch it to dot for floatval
    // For this specific Excel, it seems like numbers are 2.200.000 or 160. We assume dots are thousand separators.
    
    if (!is_numeric($cleaned_value)) {
        // Attempt to clean further if it's something like "2,5" for 2.5
        $cleaned_value_comma_decimal = str_replace(',', '.', (string)$value_from_excel);
        if (is_numeric($cleaned_value_comma_decimal)) {
            $numeric_val = floatval($cleaned_value_comma_decimal);
        } else {
            return null; // Cannot parse
        }
    } else {
        $numeric_val = floatval($cleaned_value);
    }

    // Return exact value without division for all fields including price fields
    return $numeric_val;
}

$import_message = "";
$import_error = "";

if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST" && isset($_FILES["excel_file"])) {
    $target_dir = "uploads/";
    
    // Create directory with secure permissions if it doesn't exist
    if (!file_exists($target_dir)) {
        mkdir($target_dir, 0755, true);
    }
    
    $target_file = $target_dir . basename($_FILES["excel_file"]["name"]);
    $fileType = strtolower(pathinfo($target_file, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
    
    // Check if file is an Excel file
    if ($fileType != "xlsx" && $fileType != "xls") {
        $import_error = "Only Excel files (.xlsx or .xls) are allowed.";
    } else {
        if (move_uploaded_file($_FILES["excel_file"]["tmp_name"], $target_file)) {
            // File uploaded successfully, now process it
            require 'vendor/autoload.php';
            
            try {
                $spreadsheet = \PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\IOFactory::load($target_file);
                $worksheet = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet();
                $rows = $worksheet->toArray();
                
                // Skip header row
                array_shift($rows);
                
                // Begin transaction
                $conn->begin_transaction();
                
                $properties_added = 0;
                $properties_updated = 0;
                
                foreach ($rows as $row) {
                    // Skip empty rows
                    if (empty($row[0]) && empty($row[1]) && empty($row[2])) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    // Check if property exists by ID or title
                    $property_id = !empty($row[0]) ? intval($row[0]) : null;
                    $title = !empty($row[1]) ? $row[1] : null;
                    
                    $property_exists = false;
                    $existing_id = null;
                    
                    if ($property_id) {
                        $check_sql = "SELECT PropertyID FROM Properties WHERE PropertyID = ?";
                        $check_stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql);
                        $check_stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
                        $check_stmt->execute();
                        $check_result = $check_stmt->get_result();
                        
                        if ($check_result->num_rows > 0) {
                            $property_exists = true;
                            $existing_id = $property_id;
                        }
                        $check_stmt->close();
                    }
                    
                    if (!$property_exists && $title) {
                        $check_sql = "SELECT PropertyID FROM Properties WHERE Title = ?";
                        $check_stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql);
                        $check_stmt->bind_param("s", $title);
                        $check_stmt->execute();
                        $check_result = $check_stmt->get_result();
                        
                        if ($check_result->num_rows > 0) {
                            $property_exists = true;
                            $row_data = $check_result->fetch_assoc();
                            $existing_id = $row_data['PropertyID'];
                        }
                        $check_stmt->close();
                    }
                    
                    // Parse numeric values
                    $price = parseNumericValueForDB($row[3], true);
                    $area = parseNumericValueForDB($row[4]);
                    $bedrooms = !empty($row[5]) ? intval($row[5]) : null;
                    $bathrooms = !empty($row[6]) ? intval($row[6]) : null;
                    
                    if ($property_exists) {
                        // Update existing property
                        $update_sql = "UPDATE Properties SET 
                                      Title = ?, 
                                      ProjectName = ?, 
                                      Area = ?, 
                                      Bedrooms = ?, 
                                      Location = ?, 
                                      Status = ?, 
                                      governorate = ?, 
                                      district = ? 
                                      WHERE PropertyID = ?";
                        
                        $update_stmt = $conn->prepare($update_sql);
                        $update_stmt->bind_param(
                            "ssddiisssi",
                            $row[1], // Title
                            $row[2], // ProjectName
                            $area,   // Area
                            $bedrooms, // Bedrooms
                            $row[7], // Location
                            $row[8], // Status
                            $row[9], // governorate
                            $row[10], // district
                            $existing_id // PropertyID
                        );
                        
                        if ($update_stmt->execute()) {
                            $properties_updated++;
                        } else {
                            throw new Exception("Error updating property: " . $update_stmt->error);
                        }
                        $update_stmt->close();
                    } else {
                        // Insert new property
                        $insert_sql = "INSERT INTO Properties (Title, ProjectName, Area, Bedrooms, Location, Status, governorate, district, DateAdded, EmployeeID) 
                                      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW(), ?)";
                        
                        $insert_stmt = $conn->prepare($insert_sql);
                        $insert_stmt->bind_param(
                            "ssddiisssi",
                            $row[1], // Title
                            $row[2], // ProjectName
                            $area,   // Area
                            $bedrooms, // Bedrooms
                            $row[7], // Location
                            $row[8], // Status
                            $row[9], // governorate
                            $row[10], // district
                            $_SESSION["id"] // EmployeeID
                        );
                        
                        if ($insert_stmt->execute()) {
                            $properties_added++;
                        } else {
                            throw new Exception("Error inserting property: " . $insert_stmt->error);
                        }
                        $insert_stmt->close();
                    }
                }
                
                // Commit transaction
                $conn->commit();
                
                $import_message = "Import completed successfully. Added $properties_added new properties and updated $properties_updated existing properties.";
                
                // Delete the uploaded file after processing
                unlink($target_file);
                
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                // Rollback transaction on error
                $conn->rollback();
                $import_error = "Error processing Excel file: " . $e->getMessage();
            }
        } else {
            $import_error = "Sorry, there was an error uploading your file.";
        }
    }
}

// Fetch property types for the filter dropdown
$property_types = [];
$sql_property_types = "SELECT PropertyTypeID, TypeName FROM PropertyTypes ORDER BY TypeName";
if ($stmt_types = $conn->prepare($sql_property_types)) {
    if ($stmt_types->execute()) {
        $result_types = $stmt_types->get_result();
        while ($row_type = $result_types->fetch_assoc()) {
            $property_types[$row_type['PropertyTypeID']] = $row_type['TypeName'];
        }
    }
    $stmt_types->close();
}

// Build the main SQL query with proper joins for unit design and finishing type
$sql_select = "SELECT p.*, pt.TypeName AS PropertyTypeName, e.FullName AS EmployeeName,
               p.unit_design AS UnitDesignName, pft.FinishingName AS FinishingTypeName
               FROM Properties p
               LEFT JOIN PropertyTypes pt ON p.PropertyTypeID = pt.PropertyTypeID
               LEFT JOIN Employees e ON p.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
               -- Unit design is now a text field, no join needed
               LEFT JOIN PropertyFinishingTypes pft ON p.finishing_type_id = pft.FinishingID";
$sql_where = [];
$params = [];
$types = "";

// Add listing_type filter (mandatory based on session mode)
$sql_where[] = "p.listing_type = ?";
$params[] = $current_mode;
$types .= "s";

// Add search term filter
if (!empty($search_term)) {
    $sql_where[] = "(p.Title LIKE ? OR p.ProjectName LIKE ? OR p.governorate LIKE ? OR p.district LIKE ? OR p.Location LIKE ? OR p.company_name LIKE ? OR pud.DesignName LIKE ?)";
    $search_param = "%" . $search_term . "%";
    array_push($params, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param, $search_param);
    $types .= "sssssss";
}

// Add property type filter
if (!empty($property_type_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.PropertyTypeID = ?";
    $params[] = $property_type_filter;
    $types .= "i";
}

// Add governorate filter
if (!empty($governorate_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.governorate = ?";
    $params[] = $governorate_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add company filter
if (!empty($company_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.company_name = ?";
    $params[] = $company_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add unit design filter
if (!empty($unit_design_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.unit_design = ?";
    $params[] = $unit_design_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add status filter
if (!empty($status_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.Status = ?";
    $params[] = $status_filter;
    $types .= "s";
}

// Add advanced filters
if (!empty($min_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_price_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.price_cash, p.price_installments) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_price_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($min_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.min_area) >= ?";
    $params[] = $min_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($max_area_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "COALESCE(p.Area, p.max_area) <= ?";
    $params[] = $max_area_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
    if (!empty($down_payment_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.down_payment_percentage = ?";
    $params[] = $down_payment_filter;
    $types .= "d";
}
if (!empty($payment_period_filter)) {
    $sql_where[] = "p.payment_years = ?";
    $params[] = $payment_period_filter;
    $types .= "d"; // treat payment_years as decimal/double
}

// Combine SQL parts
$sql = $sql_select;
if (!empty($sql_where)) {
    $sql .= " WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $sql_where);
}

// Add sorting
$sql .= " ORDER BY " . $allowed_sort_columns[$sort_column] . " " . strtoupper($sort_direction);

// Prepare and execute the query
$properties = [];
if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
    if (!empty($params)) {
        $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
    }

    if ($stmt->execute()) {
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $properties[] = $row;
        }
    } else {
        error_log("Error executing property query: " . $stmt->error . " | SQL: " . $sql . " | Params: " . print_r($params, true));
        $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('database_error');
    }
    $stmt->close();
} else {
    error_log("Error preparing property query: " . $conn->error . " | SQL: " . $sql);
    $_SESSION['error_message'] = t('db_error_prepare');
}

// Function to format price for display
function formatDisplayPrice($row)
{
    // Prefer cash price, then installments price. If neither exist, try meter_price * Area as estimate.
    if (!empty($row['price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['price_cash'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_cash']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['price_installments'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['price_installments']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_cash']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_cash']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_cash']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    } elseif (!empty($row['meter_price_installments']) && is_numeric($row['meter_price_installments']) && !empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        $est = floatval($row['meter_price_installments']) * floatval($row['Area']);
        return t('estimated') . ': ' . number_format($est, 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('currency');
    }
    return t('price_not_specified');
}

// Function to format area for display
function formatDisplayArea($row)
{
    if (!empty($row['Area']) && is_numeric($row['Area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['Area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area']) && !empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return number_format(floatval($row['min_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' - ' . number_format(floatval($row['max_area']), 0, '.', ',') . ' ' . t('sqm');
    } elseif (!empty($row['min_area']) && is_numeric($row['min_area'])) {
        return t("starts_from") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["min_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    } elseif (!empty($row['max_area']) && is_numeric($row['max_area'])) {
        return t("up_to") . " " . number_format(floatval($row["max_area"]), 0, ".", ",") . " " . t("sqm");
    }
    return t('area_not_specified');
}

// Function to format payment terms
function formatPaymentTerms($row)
{
    $terms = [];
    
    if (!empty($row['down_payment_percentage']) && is_numeric($row['down_payment_percentage'])) {
        $terms[] = number_format($row['down_payment_percentage'], 0) . '% ' . t('down_payment_percentage');
    }
    
    if (!empty($row['payment_years']) && is_numeric($row['payment_years'])) {
        $terms[] = $row['payment_years'] . ' ' . t('years');
    }
    
    return !empty($terms) ? implode(' + ', $terms) : t('undefined');
}

// Function to get status badge HTML
function getStatusBadge($status) {
    $status_classes = [
        'available' => 'status-available',
        'sold' => 'status-sold', 
        'rented' => 'status-rented',
        'unavailable' => 'status-unavailable'
    ];
    
    $status_icons = [
        'available' => 'fas fa-check-circle',
        'sold' => 'fas fa-handshake',
        'rented' => 'fas fa-key',
        'unavailable' => 'fas fa-times-circle'
    ];
    
    $class = $status_classes[$status] ?? 'status-unavailable';
    $icon = $status_icons[$status] ?? 'fas fa-question-circle';
    $text = t('status_' . $status);
    
    return "<span class=\"status-badge {$class}\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$text}</span>";
}

// Function to get property type badge HTML
function getPropertyTypeBadge($typeId, $typeName) {
    $type_icons = [
        1 => 'fas fa-home',      // سكني
        2 => 'fas fa-umbrella-beach', // ساحلي
        3 => 'fas fa-building',  // إداري
        4 => 'fas fa-store',     // تجاري
        5 => 'fas fa-hotel',     // فندقي
        6 => 'fas fa-hospital'   // طبي
    ];
    
    $icon = $type_icons[$typeId] ?? 'fas fa-landmark';
    
    return "<span class=\"property-type-badge\"><i class=\"{$icon}\"></i> {$typeName}</span>";
}

// Lightbox functionality for property images
class PropertyLightbox {
    constructor() {
        this.currentImageIndex = 0;
        this.images = [];
        this.lightboxElement = null;
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.createLightboxHTML();
        this.bindEvents();
        this.collectImages();
    }

    createLightboxHTML() {
        const lightboxHTML = `
            <div id="property-lightbox" class="lightbox">
                <div class="lightbox-content">
                    <span class="lightbox-close">&times;</span>
                    <span class="lightbox-nav lightbox-prev">&#10094;</span>
                    <img class="lightbox-image" src="" alt="Property Image">
                    <span class="lightbox-nav lightbox-next">&#10095;</span>
                    <div class="lightbox-counter">
                        <span class="current">1</span> / <span class="total">1</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', lightboxHTML);
        this.lightboxElement = document.getElementById('property-lightbox');
    }

    bindEvents() {
        // Close lightbox events
        const closeBtn = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-close');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.close());

        // Click outside to close
        this.lightboxElement.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === this.lightboxElement) {
                this.close();
            }
        });

        // Navigation events
        const prevBtn = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-prev');
        const nextBtn = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-next');
        
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.prev());
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.next());

        // Keyboard events
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (this.lightboxElement.style.display === 'block') {
                switch(e.key) {
                    case 'Escape':
                        this.close();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        this.prev();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                        this.next();
                        break;
                }
            }
        });

        // Image click events
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.classList.contains('property-image-clickable')) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const imageIndex = parseInt(e.target.dataset.imageIndex);
                this.open(imageIndex);
            }
        });
    }

    collectImages() {
        const imageElements = document.querySelectorAll('.property-image-clickable');
        this.images = Array.from(imageElements).map(img => ({
            src: img.src,
            alt: img.alt || 'Property Image'
        }));
    }

    open(imageIndex = 0) {
        this.collectImages(); // Refresh images list
        
        if (this.images.length === 0) return;
        
        this.currentImageIndex = imageIndex;
        this.updateImage();
        this.updateCounter();
        this.updateNavigation();
        
        this.lightboxElement.style.display = 'block';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Prevent background scrolling
    }

    close() {
        this.lightboxElement.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = ''; // Restore scrolling
    }

    prev() {
        this.currentImageIndex = (this.currentImageIndex - 1 + this.images.length) % this.images.length;
        this.updateImage();
        this.updateCounter();
    }

    next() {
        this.currentImageIndex = (this.currentImageIndex + 1) % this.images.length;
        this.updateImage();
        this.updateCounter();
    }

    updateImage() {
        const img = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-image');
        const currentImage = this.images[this.currentImageIndex];
        
        img.src = currentImage.src;
        img.alt = currentImage.alt;
    }

    updateCounter() {
        const currentSpan = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-counter .current');
        const totalSpan = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-counter .total');
        
        currentSpan.textContent = this.currentImageIndex + 1;
        totalSpan.textContent = this.images.length;
    }

    updateNavigation() {
        const prevBtn = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-prev');
        const nextBtn = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-next');
        const counter = this.lightboxElement.querySelector('.lightbox-counter');
        
        if (this.images.length <= 1) {
            prevBtn.style.display = 'none';
            nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
            counter.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            prevBtn.style.display = 'block';
            nextBtn.style.display = 'block';
            counter.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
}

// Media upload functionality
class MediaUploader {
    constructor(propertyId, csrfToken) {
        this.propertyId = propertyId;
        this.csrfToken = csrfToken;
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.bindUploadEvents();
        this.bindDeleteEvents();
    }

    bindUploadEvents() {
        // Image upload
        const imageInput = document.getElementById('image-upload');
        const imageUploadBtn = document.getElementById('image-upload-btn');
        
        if (imageUploadBtn) {
            imageUploadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => imageInput.click());
        }
        
        if (imageInput) {
            imageInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                if (e.target.files.length > 0) {
                    this.uploadFiles(e.target.files, 'image');
                }
            });
        }

        // Audio upload
        const audioInput = document.getElementById('audio-upload');
        const audioUploadBtn = document.getElementById('audio-upload-btn');
        
        if (audioUploadBtn) {
            audioUploadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => audioInput.click());
        }
        
        if (audioInput) {
            audioInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                if (e.target.files.length > 0) {
                    this.uploadFiles(e.target.files, 'audio');
                }
            });
        }

        // Drag and drop for images
        const imageUploadArea = document.getElementById('image-upload-area');
        if (imageUploadArea) {
            this.bindDragAndDrop(imageUploadArea, 'image');
        }

        // Drag and drop for audio
        const audioUploadArea = document.getElementById('audio-upload-area');
        if (audioUploadArea) {
            this.bindDragAndDrop(audioUploadArea, 'audio');
        }
    }

    bindDragAndDrop(element, type) {
        element.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            element.classList.add('dragover');
        });

        element.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
            element.classList.remove('dragover');
        });

        element.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            element.classList.remove('dragover');
            
            const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
            if (files.length > 0) {
                this.uploadFiles(files, type);
            }
        });
    }

    bindDeleteEvents() {
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.classList.contains('delete-image-btn')) {
                const imageId = e.target.dataset.imageId;
                this.deleteMedia('image', imageId, e.target);
            }
            
            if (e.target.classList.contains('delete-audio-btn')) {
                const audioId = e.target.dataset.audioId;
                this.deleteMedia('audio', audioId, e.target);
            }
        });
    }

    uploadFiles(files, type) {
        Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
            this.uploadFile(file, type);
        });
    }

    uploadFile(file, type) {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append(type, file);
        formData.append('property_id', this.propertyId);
        formData.append('upload_type', type);
        formData.append('csrf_token', this.csrfToken);

        // Create progress indicator
        const progressContainer = this.createProgressIndicator(file.name);
        
        fetch('upload_media.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
        })
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            progressContainer.remove();
            
            if (data.success) {
                this.showMessage('success', data.message);
                // Visual feedback: highlight the newly uploaded media
                if (type === 'image') {
                    this.highlightLastImage();
                }
                // Optionally add audio item feedback if needed
                // Update the media display gracefully
                this.refreshMediaDisplay(type, data);
            } else {
                this.showMessage('error', data.message);
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            progressContainer.remove();
            this.showMessage('error', 'Upload failed: ' + error.message);
        });
    }

    deleteMedia(type, mediaId, buttonElement) {
        if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this ' + type + '?')) {
            return;
        }

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('media_type', type);
        formData.append('media_id', mediaId);
        formData.append('csrf_token', this.csrfToken);

        fetch('delete_media.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
        })
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            if (data.success) {
                this.showMessage('success', data.message);
                // Remove the media item from DOM
                const mediaItem = buttonElement.closest('.image-item, .audio-item');
                if (mediaItem) {
                    mediaItem.remove();
                }
            } else {
                this.showMessage('error', data.message);
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            this.showMessage('error', 'Delete failed: ' + error.message);
        });
    }

    createProgressIndicator(filename) {
        const progressHTML = `
            <div class="upload-progress-item">
                <div>Uploading: ${filename}</div>
                <div class="upload-progress">
                    <div class="upload-progress-bar"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        const container = document.createElement('div');
        container.innerHTML = progressHTML;
        
        const uploadArea = document.querySelector('.upload-area');
        uploadArea.appendChild(container);
        
        return container;
    }

    refreshMediaDisplay(type, data) {
        // Enhanced refresh with better user feedback
        // First show immediate visual feedback, then reload to ensure data consistency
        if (type === 'image') {
            this.highlightLastImage();
        }
        
        // Provide user feedback about the save action
        this.showMessage('success', `${type === 'image' ? 'Image' : 'Audio'} uploaded successfully!`);
        
        // Reload after a short delay to ensure the new media is displayed
        setTimeout(() => {
            location.reload();
        }, 1500); // Increased delay to allow users to see the feedback
    }

    highlightLastImage() {
        // Add a temporary visual indicator to the newest image (assumes appended/rendered soon)
        const images = document.querySelectorAll('.images-grid .image-item img');
        if (images.length > 0) {
            const lastImg = images[images.length - 1];
            lastImg.style.outline = '3px solid #28a745';
            lastImg.style.outlineOffset = '2px';
            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.textContent = 'Saved!';
            overlay.style.position = 'absolute';
            overlay.style.top = '8px';
            overlay.style.right = '8px';
            overlay.style.background = 'rgba(40,167,69,0.9)';
            overlay.style.color = '#fff';
            overlay.style.padding = '4px 8px';
            overlay.style.borderRadius = '4px';
            overlay.style.fontSize = '12px';
            const wrapper = lastImg.closest('.image-item');
            if (wrapper) {
                wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
                wrapper.appendChild(overlay);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    lastImg.style.outline = '';
                    overlay.remove();
                }, 2500);
            }
        }
    }

    showMessage(type, message) {
        const messageHTML = `
            <div class="alert alert-${type === 'success' ? 'success' : 'danger'}" style="margin: 10px 0;">
                ${message}
            </div>
        `;
        
        const container = document.querySelector('.media-messages') || document.body;
        container.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', messageHTML);
        
        // Auto-remove message after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            const alertElement = container.querySelector('.alert');
            if (alertElement) {
                alertElement.remove();
            }
        }, 5000);
    }
}

// Initialize when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Initialize lightbox
    new PropertyLightbox();
    
    // Initialize media uploader if on edit page
    const propertyIdElement = document.querySelector('[data-property-id]');
    const csrfTokenElement = document.querySelector('[data-csrf-token]');
    
    if (propertyIdElement && csrfTokenElement) {
        const propertyId = propertyIdElement.dataset.propertyId;
        const csrfToken = csrfTokenElement.dataset.csrfToken;
        new MediaUploader(propertyId, csrfToken);
    }
});

<?php
require_once __DIR__ .
'/lang/translate.php'; // Include translation handler

if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// If user is already logged in, redirect to dashboard
if (isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) && $_SESSION["loggedin"] === true) {
    header("Location: dashboard.php");
    exit;
}

// Include the database connection file
require_once 'db.php';

$error_message = '';
$username_value = ''; // To retain username on error

// Check for timeout messages
if (isset($_GET['timeout'])) {
    if ($_GET['timeout'] === 'idle') {
        $error_message = t('session_timeout_idle');
    } elseif ($_GET['timeout'] === 'absolute') {
        $error_message = t('session_timeout_absolute');
    }
}

// Process form submission
if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") {
    $username_value = isset($_POST['username']) ? trim($_POST['username']) : '';

    if (empty(trim($_POST["username"]))) {
        $error_message = t('username_required');
    } else {
        $username = trim($_POST["username"]);
    }

    if (empty(trim($_POST["password"]))) {
        $error_message = t('password_required');
    } else {
        $password = $_POST["password"];
    }

    if (empty($error_message)) {
        $sql = "SELECT EmployeeID, Username, Password, Role, FullName FROM employees WHERE Username = ?";

        if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
            $stmt->bind_param("s", $param_username);
            $param_username = $username;
            
            if ($stmt->execute()) {
                $stmt->store_result();
                
                if ($stmt->num_rows == 1) {
                    $stmt->bind_result($employee_id, $db_username, $hashed_password, $role, $full_name);
                    if ($stmt->fetch()) {
                        if (password_verify($password, $hashed_password)) {
                            session_regenerate_id(true);
                            
                            $_SESSION["loggedin"] = true;
                            $_SESSION["employee_id"] = $employee_id;
                            $_SESSION["username"] = $db_username;
                            $_SESSION["role"] = $role;
                            $_SESSION["full_name"] = $full_name;
                            $_SESSION["created_at"] = time();
                            $_SESSION["last_activity"] = time();
                            // Language preference could be saved here if needed
                            
                            header("Location: dashboard.php");
                            exit();
                        } else {
                            $error_message = t('invalid_password');
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    $error_message = t('no_account_found');
                }
            } else {
                error_log("Error executing login statement: " . $stmt->error);
                $error_message = t('login_error');
            }
            $stmt->close();
        } else {
            error_log("Error preparing login statement: " . $conn->error);
            $error_message = t('login_error'); // Use generic error message
        }
    }
    // Close connection only after all operations are done
    if (isset($conn)) {
        $conn->close();
    }
}

<?php
// Start session if not already started
if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

// Unset all session variables
session_unset();

// Destroy the session
session_destroy();

// Clear session cookie
if (ini_get("session.use_cookies")) {
    $params = session_get_cookie_params();
    setcookie(session_name(), '', time() - 42000,
        $params["path"], $params["domain"],
        $params["secure"], $params["httponly"]
    );
}

// Redirect to login page
header("Location: login.php?logout=success");
exit;
?>

<?php
// Media helper functions for property images and audio notes

/**
 * Ensure $conn is a live mysqli connection. If missing or closed, re-require the
 * project's db.php to (re)create it.
 */
function ensure_db_conn(&$conn)
{
    // Determine whether we need to (re)create the connection
    $needCreate = true;

    if (isset($conn) && ($conn instanceof mysqli)) {
        $needCreate = false;

        // Try a safe ping; ping() may throw if the object is closed, so catch any errors
        $pingOk = false;
        if (method_exists($conn, 'ping')) {
            try {
                $pingOk = $conn->ping();
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $pingOk = false;
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback: check connect_errno if available
            $pingOk = (isset($conn->connect_errno) && $conn->connect_errno === 0);
        }

        if (!$pingOk) {
            $needCreate = true;
        }
    }

    if ($needCreate) {
        // If a global $conn exists and is live, reuse it
        if (isset($GLOBALS['conn']) && ($GLOBALS['conn'] instanceof mysqli)) {
            $globalConn = $GLOBALS['conn'];
            try {
                if ($globalConn->ping()) {
                    $conn = $globalConn;
                    return;
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // continue to attempt creating a new connection
            }
        }

        // Create a new mysqli connection directly (avoid re-requiring db.php which
        // defines functions and may cause redeclaration errors if included multiple times).
        $host = getenv('DB_HOST') ?: "127.0.0.1";
        $user = getenv('DB_USER') ?: "root";
        $pass = getenv('DB_PASS') ?: "";
        $dbname = getenv('DB_NAME') ?: "broman_db";

        try {
            $newConn = new mysqli($host, $user, $pass, $dbname);
            // Try to set charset similar to db.php
            @$newConn->set_charset("utf8mb4");
            $conn = $newConn;
            $GLOBALS['conn'] = $conn;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            // If creating a new connection fails, log and leave $conn as-is (null/invalid)
            error_log("ensure_db_conn: failed to create mysqli: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Get all images for a property
 */
function getPropertyImages($property_id, $conn) {
    $images = [];
    ensure_db_conn($conn);
    $sql = "SELECT image_id, file_path, upload_date, is_primary FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ? ORDER BY is_primary DESC, upload_date ASC";
    
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $images[] = $row;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    }
    
    return $images;
}

/**
 * Get all audio notes for a property
 */
function getPropertyAudioNotes($property_id, $conn) {
    $audio_notes = [];
    ensure_db_conn($conn);
    $sql = "SELECT note_id, file_path, upload_date, duration FROM property_audio_notes WHERE property_id = ? ORDER BY upload_date ASC";
    
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $audio_notes[] = $row;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    }
    
    return $audio_notes;
}

/**
 * Get all videos for a property
 */
function getPropertyVideos($property_id, $conn) {
    $videos = [];
    ensure_db_conn($conn);
    $sql = "SELECT VideoID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, UploadDate FROM property_videos WHERE PropertyID = ? ORDER BY UploadDate ASC";
    
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $videos[] = $row;
        }
        $stmt->close();
    }
    
    return $videos;
}

/**
 * Get primary image for a property (for card view)
 */
function getPropertyPrimaryImage($property_id, $conn) {
    ensure_db_conn($conn);
    $sql = "SELECT file_path FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ? AND is_primary = 1 LIMIT 1";
    
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        if ($result->num_rows === 1) {
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
            $stmt->close();
            return $row['file_path'];
        }
        $stmt->close();
    }
    
    // If no primary image, get the first image
    $sql = "SELECT file_path FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ? ORDER BY upload_date ASC LIMIT 1";
    
    if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($sql)) {
        $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt->execute();
        $result = $stmt->get_result();
        
        if ($result->num_rows === 1) {
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
            $stmt->close();
            return $row['file_path'];
        }
        $stmt->close();
    }
    
    return null; // No images found
}

/**
 * Set an image as primary
 */
function setImageAsPrimary($image_id, $property_id, $conn) {
    ensure_db_conn($conn);
    // First, remove primary flag from all images of this property
    $sql1 = "UPDATE property_images SET is_primary = 0 WHERE property_id = ?";
    if ($stmt1 = $conn->prepare($sql1)) {
        $stmt1->bind_param("i", $property_id);
        $stmt1->execute();
        $stmt1->close();
    }
    
    // Then set the specified image as primary
    $sql2 = "UPDATE property_images SET is_primary = 1 WHERE image_id = ? AND property_id = ?";
    if ($stmt2 = $conn->prepare($sql2)) {
        $stmt2->bind_param("ii", $image_id, $property_id);
        $result = $stmt2->execute();
        $stmt2->close();
        return $result;
    }
    
    return false;
}

/**
 * Format file size for display
 */
function formatFileSize($bytes) {
    if ($bytes >= 1073741824) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1073741824, 2) . ' GB';
    } elseif ($bytes >= 1048576) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1048576, 2) . ' MB';
    } elseif ($bytes >= 1024) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1024, 2) . ' KB';
    } else {
        return $bytes . ' bytes';
    }
}

/**
 * Format duration for audio files
 */
function formatDuration($seconds) {
    if ($seconds === null) {
        return 'Unknown';
    }
    
    $minutes = floor($seconds / 60);
    $seconds = $seconds % 60;
    
    return sprintf('%02d:%02d', $minutes, $seconds);
}


/**
 * Move temporary uploads from a session temp folder into the property's media and create DB entries.
 * session_id should be the PHP session id (session_id()).
 */
function moveTempUploadsToProperty($property_id, $session_id, $conn) {
    $base = __DIR__ . '/uploads/';
    $tempDir = $base . 'temp/' . $session_id . '/';
    if (!is_dir($tempDir)) return false;

    $moved = ['images' => [], 'audio' => [], 'videos' => []];

    // Images
    $tempImagesDir = $tempDir . 'images/';
    if (is_dir($tempImagesDir)) {
        $files = scandir($tempImagesDir);
        foreach ($files as $f) {
            if (in_array($f, ['.', '..'])) continue;
            $src = $tempImagesDir . $f;
            $dst = $base . 'images/' . $f;
            if (rename($src, $dst)) {
                // Determine if primary (if no images exist yet)
                $is_primary = 0;
                $check_sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM property_images WHERE property_id = ?";
                if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($check_sql)) {
                    $stmt->bind_param("i", $property_id);
                    $stmt->execute();
                    $result = $stmt->get_result();
                    $row = $result->fetch_assoc();
                    $is_primary = ($row['count'] == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                    $stmt->close();
                }

                $relative = 'uploads/images/' . $f;
                $ins = "INSERT INTO property_images (property_id, file_path, is_primary) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                    $stmt->bind_param("isi", $property_id, $relative, $is_primary);
                    $stmt->execute();
                    $stmt->close();
                    $moved['images'][] = $relative;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Audio
    $tempAudioDir = $tempDir . 'audio/';
    if (is_dir($tempAudioDir)) {
        $files = scandir($tempAudioDir);
        foreach ($files as $f) {
            if (in_array($f, ['.', '..'])) continue;
            $src = $tempAudioDir . $f;
            $dst = $base . 'audio/' . $f;
            if (rename($src, $dst)) {
                $relative = 'uploads/audio/' . $f;
                $ins = "INSERT INTO property_audio_notes (property_id, file_path, duration) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
                if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                    $duration = null;
                    $stmt->bind_param("isi", $property_id, $relative, $duration);
                    $stmt->execute();
                    $stmt->close();
                    $moved['audio'][] = $relative;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Videos
    $tempVideosDir = $tempDir . 'videos/';
    if (is_dir($tempVideosDir)) {
        $files = scandir($tempVideosDir);
        foreach ($files as $f) {
            if (in_array($f, ['.', '..'])) continue;
            $src = $tempVideosDir . $f;
            $dst = $base . 'videos/' . $f;
            if (rename($src, $dst)) {
                $relative = 'uploads/videos/' . $f;
                $ins = "INSERT INTO property_videos (PropertyID, VideoPath, VideoName, VideoSize, EmployeeID) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
                if ($stmt = $conn->prepare($ins)) {
                    // We don't have original name/size here; attempt to use filename and filesize
                    $videoName = $f;
                    $videoSize = filesize($dst);
                    $employee_id = $_SESSION['employee_id'] ?? null;
                    $stmt->bind_param("issii", $property_id, $relative, $videoName, $videoSize, $employee_id);
                    $stmt->execute();
                    $stmt->close();
                    $moved['videos'][] = $relative;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Cleanup temp dir if empty
    // Attempt to remove directories
    @rmdir($tempDir . 'images/');
    @rmdir($tempDir . 'audio/');
    @rmdir($tempDir . 'videos/');
    @rmdir($tempDir);

    return $moved;
}

<?php
// Clean navbar.php
require_once __DIR__ . '/lang/translate.php';
require_once 'session_check.php';
require_once 'permissions.php';

if (session_status() == PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_start();
}

$is_logged_in = isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) && $_SESSION["loggedin"] === true;
$user_role = isset($_SESSION["role"]) ? $_SESSION["role"] : null;
$user_full_name = isset($_SESSION["full_name"]) ? htmlspecialchars($_SESSION["full_name"]) : "Guest";

$active_page = basename($_SERVER["PHP_SELF"]);
$logo_path = "images/broman_logo.png";

$current_lang = get_lang_code();
$switch_lang = ($current_lang == 'ar') ? 'en' : 'ar';
$switch_lang_text = ($current_lang == 'ar') ? t('switch_language_en') : t('switch_language_ar');

$query_params = $_GET;
$query_params['lang'] = $switch_lang;
$switch_lang_url = basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']) . '?' . http_build_query($query_params);

?>
<nav class="navbar">
    <div class="logo-container">
        <a href="dashboard.php" class="company-name-link">
            <img src="<?php echo $logo_path; ?>" alt="<?php echo t('broman_real_estate_logo'); ?>" class="logo">
        </a>
    </div>
    <ul>
        <?php if ($is_logged_in): ?>
            <li><a href="dashboard.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "dashboard.php") ? "active" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('dashboard'); ?></a></li>
            <?php if (isset($_SESSION['listing_context'])): ?>
            <li class="dropdown <?php echo (in_array($active_page, ["index_properties.php", "residential_properties.php", "coastal_properties.php", "commercial_properties.php", "edit_property.php"])) ? "active" : ""; ?>">
                <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="dropbtn"><?php echo t('properties'); ?> <span class="arrow">&#9662;</span></a>
                <div class="dropdown-content">
                    <a href="index_properties.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "index_properties.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('all_properties'); ?></a>
                    <a href="residential_properties.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "residential_properties.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('residential_properties'); ?></a>
                    <a href="coastal_properties.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "coastal_properties.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('coastal_properties'); ?></a>
                    <a href="commercial_properties.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "commercial_properties.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('commercial_administrative_medical_hotel'); ?></a>
                </div>
            </li>
            <?php if (can_manage_properties()): ?>
            <li class="dropdown <?php echo (in_array($active_page, ["add_residential_property.php", "add_coastal_property.php", "add_other_property.php"])) ? "active" : ""; ?>">
                 <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="dropbtn"><?php echo t('add_new_property'); ?> <span class="arrow">&#9662;</span></a>
                 <div class="dropdown-content">
                    <a href="add_residential_property.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "add_residential_property.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('add_residential_property_title'); ?></a>
                    <a href="add_coastal_property.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "add_coastal_property.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('add_coastal_property_title'); ?></a>
                    <a href="add_other_property.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "add_other_property.php") ? "active-sub" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('add_other_property_title'); ?></a>
                 </div>
            </li>
            <?php endif; ?>
            <?php endif; ?>

            <?php if (can_manage_employees()): ?>
                <li><a href="employees_list.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "employees_list.php" || $active_page == "add_employee.php" || $active_page == "edit_employee.php") ? "active" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('employees'); ?></a></li>
            <?php endif; ?>
            <li>
                <form action="logout.php" method="POST" style="display: inline;">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-logout"><?php echo sprintf(t('logout_user'), $user_full_name); ?></button>
                </form>
            </li>
        <?php else: ?>
            <li><a href="login.php" class="<?php echo ($active_page == "login.php") ? "active" : ""; ?>"><?php echo t('login'); ?></a></li>
        <?php endif; ?>
         <li><a href="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($switch_lang_url); ?>" class="lang-switch"><?php echo $switch_lang_text; ?></a></li>
    </ul>
</nav>

<?php
/**
 * نظام إدارة الصلاحيات للأدوار المختلفة
 * 
 * الأدوار:
 * - manager: جميع الصلاحيات
 * - admin: إدارة العقارات (إضافة، تعديل، حذف)
 * - user: عرض العقارات فقط
 */

// التأكد من بدء الجلسة
require_once __DIR__ . '/security.php';
ensure_secure_session_started();

/**
 * فحص ما إذا كان المستخدم مسجل دخول
 */
function is_logged_in() {
    return isset($_SESSION["loggedin"]) && $_SESSION["loggedin"] === true;
}

/**
 * الحصول على دور المستخدم الحالي
 */
function get_user_role() {
    return isset($_SESSION["role"]) ? $_SESSION["role"] : null;
}

/**
 * فحص ما إذا كان المستخدم مدير
 */
function is_manager() {
    return get_user_role() === 'manager';
}

/**
 * فحص ما إذا كان المستخدم مسؤول
 */
function is_admin() {
    return get_user_role() === 'admin';
}

/**
 * فحص ما إذا كان المستخدم عادي
 */
function is_user() {
    return get_user_role() === 'user';
}

/**
 * فحص صلاحية إدارة الموظفين
 * فقط المدير يمكنه إدارة الموظفين
 */
function can_manage_employees() {
    return is_manager();
}

/**
 * فحص صلاحية إدارة العقارات (إضافة، تعديل، حذف)
 * المدير والمسؤول يمكنهما إدارة العقارات
 */
function can_manage_properties() {
    return is_manager() || is_admin();
}

/**
 * فحص صلاحية عرض العقارات
 * جميع المستخدمين يمكنهم عرض العقارات
 */
function can_view_properties() {
    return is_logged_in();
}

/**
 * فحص صلاحية الوصول لصفحة معينة
 */
function check_permission($required_permission) {
    if (!is_logged_in()) {
        header("Location: login.php");
        exit;
    }
    
    switch ($required_permission) {
        case 'manage_employees':
            if (!can_manage_employees()) {
                $_SESSION["error_message"] = "ليس لديك صلاحية للوصول إلى هذه الصفحة.";
                header("Location: dashboard.php");
                exit;
            }
            break;
            
        case 'manage_properties':
            if (!can_manage_properties()) {
                $_SESSION["error_message"] = "ليس لديك صلاحية لإدارة العقارات.";
                header("Location: dashboard.php");
                exit;
            }
            break;
            
        case 'view_properties':
            if (!can_view_properties()) {
                $_SESSION["error_message"] = "ليس لديك صلاحية لعرض العقارات.";
                header("Location: dashboard.php");
                exit;
            }
            break;
            
        default:
            // صلاحية غير معروفة
            $_SESSION["error_message"] = "صلاحية غير صحيحة.";
            header("Location: dashboard.php");
            exit;
    }
}

/**
 * الحصول على اسم الدور باللغة العربية
 */
function get_role_name_ar($role) {
    switch ($role) {
        case 'manager':
            return 'مدير';
        case 'admin':
            return 'مسؤول';
        case 'user':
            return 'مستخدم';
        default:
            return 'غير محدد';
    }
}

/**
 * الحصول على اسم الدور باللغة الإنجليزية
 */
function get_role_name_en($role) {
    switch ($role) {
        case 'manager':
            return 'Manager';
        case 'admin':
            return 'Admin';
        case 'user':
            return 'User';
        default:
            return 'Unknown';
    }
}
?>

FILE: PRIMARY_RESALE_IMPLEMENTATION.md
============================================================
# Primary/Resale Property Classification System Implementation

## Overview
This document describes the comprehensive implementation of the Primary/Resale property classification system for the Broman Real Estate Management System. The system enforces a clear separation between Primary and Resale properties through a session-based operating mode.

## Architecture

### Core Concept: "Operating Mode"
The entire system operates in one of two modes:
- **Primary Mode**: User works exclusively with Primary properties
- **Resale Mode**: User works exclusively with Resale properties

The user's choice is stored in `$_SESSION['listing_context']` and dictates their entire workflow.

## Database Changes

### Schema Update
Added a new column to the `Properties` table:
```sql
ALTER TABLE Properties 
ADD COLUMN listing_type ENUM('Primary', 'Resale') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Primary' AFTER Status;
```

## Implementation Details

### 1. Dashboard (dashboard.php)
**Changes Made:**
- Replaced property type statistics with Primary/Resale counts
- Added two main action cards:
  - "Primary Properties" → links to `set_mode.php?mode=Primary`
  - "Resale Properties" → links to `set_mode.php?mode=Resale`
- Removed individual property type cards (Residential, Coastal, Commercial)

**New SQL Query:**
```sql
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN listing_type = 'Primary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS primary_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN listing_type = 'Resale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resale_count
FROM properties
```

### 2. Mode Setting Script (set_mode.php)
**New File Created:**
- Validates mode parameter ('Primary' or 'Resale')
- Sets `$_SESSION['listing_context']` to the chosen mode
- Redirects to `index_properties.php`

### 3. Property List Pages
**Updated Files:**
- `index_properties.php`
- `residential_properties.php`
- `coastal_properties.php`
- `commercial_properties.php`

**Changes Made:**
- **Mode Enforcement**: Redirect to dashboard if no mode is set
- **Mandatory Filtering**: All SQL queries now include `p.listing_type = ?` filter
- **Dynamic Titles**: Page titles now include the current mode (e.g., "Primary Coastal Properties")
- **Simplified Navigation**: Links no longer need parameters; session handles context

**Example Query Update:**
```sql
-- Before
SELECT p.* FROM Properties p WHERE p.PropertyTypeID = 1

-- After  
SELECT p.* FROM Properties p 
WHERE p.PropertyTypeID = 1 AND p.listing_type = ?
```

### 4. Add Property Pages
**Updated Files:**
- `add_residential_property.php`
- `add_coastal_property.php`
- `add_other_property.php`

**Changes Made:**
- **Mode Enforcement**: Redirect to dashboard if no mode is set
- **Removed Dropdown**: No listing_type selection field
- **Hidden Field**: Added `<input type="hidden" name="listing_type" value="<?php echo $current_mode; ?>">`
- **Display Field**: Shows current mode as read-only information
- **Database Insert**: Automatically uses session mode for listing_type

### 5. Edit Property Page (edit_property.php)
**Changes Made:**
- **Mode Enforcement**: Redirect to dashboard if no mode is set
- **Read-Only Display**: Shows property's listing_type as non-editable information
- **No Update**: listing_type is excluded from UPDATE queries to prevent changes

### 6. Navigation Updates (property_header_tabs.php)
**Changes Made:**
- **Dynamic Titles**: Page titles now include current mode
- **Simplified Links**: Navigation links are static (no parameters needed)

## Localization

### New Translation Keys Added
**English (lang/en.php):**
- `'manage_primary_properties' => 'Manage Primary Properties'`
- `'manage_resale_properties' => 'Manage Resale Properties'`
- `'primary_properties' => 'Primary Properties'`
- `'resale_properties' => 'Resale Properties'`
- `'choose_operating_mode' => 'Choose Your Operating Mode'`
- `'listing_type' => 'Listing Type'`

**Arabic (lang/ar.php):**
- `'manage_primary_properties' => 'إدارة العقارات الأولية'`
- `'manage_resale_properties' => 'إدارة عقارات إعادة البيع'`
- `'primary_properties' => 'العقارات الأولية'`
- `'resale_properties' => 'عقارات إعادة البيع'`
- `'choose_operating_mode' => 'اختر وضع التشغيل الخاص بك'`
- `'listing_type' => 'نوع القائمة'`

## User Workflow

### 1. Login & Mode Selection
1. User logs in and is redirected to dashboard
2. Dashboard shows two main options: "Primary Properties" or "Resale Properties"
3. User clicks their choice, which sets their operating mode
4. User is redirected to the main properties page in their chosen mode

### 2. Property Management
- **Viewing**: All property lists automatically filter by the user's mode
- **Adding**: New properties automatically get the correct listing_type
- **Editing**: Property listing_type is displayed but cannot be changed
- **Navigation**: All property pages respect the user's mode

### 3. Mode Persistence
- Mode choice persists throughout the user's session
- If user tries to access property pages without a mode, they're redirected to dashboard
- Mode can only be changed by returning to dashboard and making a new selection

## Security & Data Integrity

### Session-Based Security
- Mode enforcement prevents unauthorized access to properties
- Session validation on all property-related pages
- Automatic redirect to dashboard if session is invalid

### Data Integrity
- listing_type is set automatically during property creation
- listing_type cannot be modified during property editing
- All queries enforce mode filtering to prevent data leakage

## Benefits

1. **Clear Separation**: Complete isolation between Primary and Resale workflows
2. **Intuitive UX**: User chooses their path once and stays in that context
3. **Data Integrity**: No accidental mixing of property types
4. **Simplified Navigation**: No complex parameter passing
5. **Robust Architecture**: Session-based enforcement prevents bugs

## Technical Notes

### Database Migration
To implement this system, run the following SQL:
```sql
ALTER TABLE Properties 
ADD COLUMN listing_type ENUM('Primary', 'Resale') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Primary' AFTER Status;

UPDATE Properties SET listing_type = 'Primary' WHERE listing_type IS NULL OR listing_type = '';
```

### Session Management
The system relies on PHP sessions. Ensure session handling is properly configured in your environment.

### Performance
The additional WHERE clause on listing_type is minimal and should not impact performance significantly.

## Future Enhancements

1. **Mode Switching**: Add ability to switch modes without returning to dashboard
2. **Mode Indicators**: Visual indicators showing current mode in navigation
3. **Mode Preferences**: Remember user's preferred mode across sessions
4. **Advanced Filtering**: Additional filters within each mode
5. **Reporting**: Separate reports for Primary vs Resale properties
